full.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg
full.title: Asset Details Ch Agg
full.description: Primary aggregated asset cube combining normalised asset attributes, rolled-up insight arrays, and 7-day user logon summaries. Grain is one row per asset (CQID). Each row exposes: (1) common asset fields - name, OS, vendor, model, IP/MAC addresses, categories, location, managed status, first/last seen, tags, and source table; (2) aggregated security insight context - insight types, indicators, confidence levels, severities, states, sub-classifications, and pre-computed composite keys such as insight_types_confidence_levels; and (3) user activity rollups - distinct user count plus user-to-name/action/timestamp maps. This is the default workhorse cube for all general asset queries — use it with or without insight filtering. Use for any asset enumeration or attribute-based lookup, for example "list all Windows servers", "show all managed Linux devices by region", "list managed assets by OS and vendor", "find assets by name or IP", as well as insight-filtered analytics such as "show assets with active security insights by OS" or "list devices with recent user activity and violations". Insight fields here (classification, sub-classification, indicator, confidence, severity, state) are stored as per-asset arrays: use them to FILTER assets that have a given insight, but NOT to GROUP or break down BY an insight value — grouping operates on the whole array, not individual values, and produces incorrect counts. For any query that groups by, breaks down by, or counts WITHIN an insight dimension (e.g. "zombie assets by sub-classification", "count insights by severity", "breakdown by classification and confidence"), use AssetInsightOnly (pure insight breakdown, minimal asset context) or AssetDetails_ch (one row per asset-insight, when the breakdown also groups by or returns asset attributes such as provider, OS, region, or vendor) instead. For interface- or provider-specific raw fields, use the corresponding *_agg_expanded cubes. Time dimension: default to updated_at scoped to the last 7 days from now (to the minute); if the user specifies a time range — for example "in the last 3 hours", "over the past 2 days", or "not in the last 3 days" — apply those constraints instead, as user-specified time always takes priority over the default.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg AccountId
dimensions.description: Internal tenant account identifier, automatically filtered by the platform's security context. Use when tenant-level filtering is needed. See cqid for the asset identifier.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.cqid
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg CQID
dimensions.description: Unique asset identifier assigned during discovery. Use when filtering or looking up a specific asset by its ID (CQID). See composite_id for the compound row-uniqueness key.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.composite_id
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg CompositeID
dimensions.description: Composite key combining account_id and cqid, used as the internal primary key for row-level uniqueness. Use when a unique row identifier is needed. See cqid for the standalone asset identifier.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.categories
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Type_old
dimensions.description: All asset categories as a JSON array. One asset may belong to multiple categories. Use when asking about 'asset types' or 'categories'. For human-readable names, use categories_label. For high-level grouping, use super_category instead.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.categories_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Type Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable display names for asset categories as a JSON array. Prefer this over categories for display. Use when the user refers to categories by friendly name. For raw category values, see categories.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg CIDR
dimensions.description: Network CIDR blocks associated with the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about 'network ranges', 'subnets', or 'CIDR blocks' of an asset.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.cloud_account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg CloudAccountID
dimensions.description: Cloud provider account ID (e.g., AWS account ID, Azure subscription). Use when filtering by 'cloud account', 'AWS account', or grouping assets by their cloud account.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.context
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Location Type
dimensions.description: Discovery context indicating the asset's deployment environment (e.g., on-prem, cloud). Use when asking about 'location type' or filtering cloud vs on-premises assets. For geographic region details, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.dhcp_fingerprint
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg DHCPFingerprint
dimensions.description: DHCP fingerprint string used for network-level device identification. Use when asking about 'DHCP fingerprint' or 'device fingerprinting'.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.discovery_host
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg OPHID
dimensions.description: Display name of the on-premises discovery host that found this asset. For the unique on-prem host identifier, use ophid instead. Primarily for internal reference.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.indicator_rule_ids
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg IndicatorRuleID
dimensions.description: Array of insight indicator rule IDs that triggered findings for this asset. Used for programmatic filtering of specific insight rules. For indicator identifiers, use insight_indicators; for display names, use insight_indicators_label.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insight_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Classifications
dimensions.description: Distinct insight classifications for this asset as a JSON array (e.g., ["registration", "security"]). Use when asking 'what types of insights'. For display names, use insight_classifications_label. For finer detail, see insight_sub_classifications. This is a per-asset array suitable for FILTERING (assets that have a given classification); do NOT group or break down by it — grouping operates on the whole array, not individual values. To group or count by classification, use AssetInsightOnly.insight_classification (insight-only) or AssetDetails_ch.insight_classification (with asset attributes).

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insight_classifications_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Classifications Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight classifications as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_classifications for display. Use when the user asks about insight types by friendly name. For raw values, see insight_classifications.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insight_confidences
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Confidence
dimensions.description: Array of confidence levels for all insights on this asset (e.g., ["high", "medium"]). Use when filtering assets by confidence. For display labels, use insight_confidences_label. This is a per-asset array suitable for FILTERING; do NOT group or break down by it — grouping operates on the whole array, not individual values. To group or count by confidence, use AssetInsightOnly.insight_confidence (insight-only) or AssetDetails_ch.insight_confidence (with asset attributes).

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insight_confidences_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg InsightConfidenceslabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight confidence levels as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_confidences for display. For raw confidence values used in filtering, see insight_confidences.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insight_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Indicator
dimensions.description: Array of insight indicator IDs for this asset. Each indicator represents a specific security check that was triggered. Use when filtering by indicator. For display names, use insight_indicators_label. For rule definitions, see indicator_rule_ids. This is a per-asset array suitable for FILTERING; do NOT group or break down by it — grouping operates on the whole array, not individual values. To group or count by indicator, use AssetInsightOnly.insight_indicator (insight-only) or AssetDetails_ch.insight_indicator (with asset attributes).

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insight_indicators_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg InsightIndicatorslabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight indicators as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_indicators for display. For raw indicator IDs used in filtering, see insight_indicators.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insight_registration_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg MissingRecords
dimensions.description: Array of distinct registration-type insight indicators identifying missing records or registration issues. Use when asking 'what registration indicators' or 'missing records'. For display labels, use insight_registration_indicators_label. For registration status, see insight_registration_statuses.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insight_registration_indicators_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg RegistrationIndicatorslabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for registration indicators as a JSON array. Prefer this for display when showing missing records by friendly name. For raw indicator IDs, see insight_registration_indicators.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insight_registration_statuses
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg RegistrationStatus
dimensions.description: Array of distinct registration statuses for this asset (e.g., ["registered"], ["unregistered"]). Use when asking 'is the asset registered' or 'show unregistered assets'. For display labels, use insight_registration_statuses_label. For which rules triggered, see insight_registration_indicators.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insight_registration_statuses_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Registration Statuses Label
dimensions.description: Capitalized display labels for registration statuses (e.g., ["Registered"], ["Unregistered"]). Prefer this over insight_registration_statuses for display. For raw status values, see insight_registration_statuses.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insight_states
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg InsightStates
dimensions.description: Array of insight states (e.g., ["active", "none"]). Primarily for Builder compatibility. For filtering by insight type, prefer insight_classifications or insight_sub_classifications. This is a per-asset array suitable for FILTERING; do NOT group or break down by it. To group or count by insight state, use AssetInsightOnly.insight_state (insight-only) or AssetDetails_ch.insight_state (with asset attributes).

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insight_sub_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg SubClassifications
dimensions.description: Array of insight sub-classifications providing finer detail within a classification. Use when filtering by sub-classification. For display labels, use insight_sub_classifications_label. For broader grouping, see insight_classifications. This is a per-asset array suitable for FILTERING (assets that have a given sub-classification); do NOT group or break down by it — grouping operates on the whole array, not individual values. To group or count by sub-classification, use AssetInsightOnly.insight_sub_classification (insight-only) or AssetDetails_ch.insight_sub_classification (with asset attributes).

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insight_sub_classifications_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg SubClassifications Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight sub-classifications as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_sub_classifications for display. For raw sub-classification values, see insight_sub_classifications.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg IPAddresses
dimensions.description: All IP addresses of the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about an asset's IP addresses or displaying the full list of IPs.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.ips_for_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Ips for Filter
dimensions.description: Internal dimension for filter pushdown optimization on IP addresses. Used by the query builder infrastructure for efficient IP-based filtering.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.location
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg AssetLocation
dimensions.description: Raw location string of the asset. Primarily for Builder compatibility. For human-readable location, use provider_region_label instead.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg MACAddresses
dimensions.description: All MAC addresses of the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about 'MAC addresses' or displaying hardware network identifiers per asset.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.managed
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Managed
dimensions.description: Whether the asset is managed (true) or unmanaged (false). Use when asking 'show managed assets', 'unmanaged devices', or filtering by management status.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.model
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Model
dimensions.description: Hardware model of the asset/device (e.g., "Cisco ISR 4331"). Use when asking about 'device model', 'hardware model', or grouping by model.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.name
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Name
dimensions.description: Display name or hostname of the asset. Use when searching by name, e.g., 'find asset named X', or when displaying asset details.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.ophid
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg DiscoveryHost
dimensions.description: On-Prem Host ID, the unique identifier of the on-premises host or appliance associated with this asset. Use when filtering by OPHID or looking up assets tied to a specific on-prem host. For the display name, see discovery_host.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.os
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg OperatingSystem
dimensions.description: Operating system name of the asset (e.g., "Windows 10", "Ubuntu 22.04", "IOS-XE"). Use when asking 'what OS' or filtering by operating system. For the OS family, see os_type. For the version number, see os_version.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.perspective_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg PerspectiveTags
dimensions.description: All perspective tags for the asset as a JSON array. Use when querying perspective-level tag classifications. For user-defined or system tags, see combined_tags.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.provider
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Provider
dimensions.description: Primary discovery source or cloud provider (e.g., "aws", "azure", "gcp", "nios", "servicenow"). Raw internal value. For display, use provider_label. For all sources including secondary, use providers.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.provider_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg ProviderLabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable provider name with proper casing (e.g., "AWS", "GCP", "Azure", "ServiceNow"). Prefer this over provider for display. For the raw value, see provider. For all sources, use providers_label.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.providers_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: All discovery providers for this asset as a formatted JSON array with proper casing. Use when displaying the full list of sources. For raw source values, see providers. For the single primary provider, see provider_label.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.providers_label_iterator
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: Each source/provider unnested into individual rows with display labels. An asset discovered by 3 providers produces 3 rows. Use when grouping or filtering by all sources. For raw values, use providers_iterator. For primary source only, use provider.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.provider_region_label_old
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg ProviderandLocationlabel_old
dimensions.description: Legacy format of provider+region label (e.g., "AWS: us-east-1"). Used internally by provider_region_label. Prefer provider_region_label for current region display.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.provider_region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Location_label
dimensions.description: Human-readable region label (e.g., "AWS US East (N. Virginia)", "Unassigned"). Use when asking 'which region', 'show assets by region', or displaying location. For raw region codes, see provider_region.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.provider_region
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Location
dimensions.description: Raw provider region code (e.g., "us-east-1", "westus2"). Use when filtering by exact region code. For display-friendly version, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.provider_label_filter_based
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Providerlabelfromfilter
dimensions.description: Provider label derived from the reconciliation filter value. Used internally by the reconciliation dimension for formatting. For provider display names, use provider_label.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.reconciliation
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Reconciliation
dimensions.description: Cross-source reconciliation status for a given provider filter. Values: 'Matching' (found in selected provider and others), 'Missing From X', 'Only in X'. Use when asking 'which assets are missing from AWS' or 'reconciliation report'. Requires reconciliation_filter to be set.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.reconciliation_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Reconciliationfilter
dimensions.description: Filter dimension to select which provider to reconcile against (e.g., "aws"). Set this filter to enable reconciliation analysis via the reconciliation dimension.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.region
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Region
dimensions.description: Raw cloud region code. Primarily for Builder compatibility. Prefer provider_region for region filtering and provider_region_label for display.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Region Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable cloud region label (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Primarily for Builder compatibility. Prefer provider_region_label for region display.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.resource
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Resource
dimensions.description: Full raw asset record as a JSON string. Primarily for Builder compatibility. Use when the user wants to inspect the complete raw asset payload.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.secondary_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg SecondaryProviders
dimensions.description: Additional discovery sources beyond the primary provider as a JSON array. Primarily for Builder compatibility. For the complete list of all sources, use providers instead.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.severities
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Severity
dimensions.description: Array of insight severity levels for this asset. Primarily for Builder compatibility. Values include "critical", "high", "medium", "low". This is a per-asset array suitable for FILTERING; do NOT group or break down by it — grouping operates on the whole array, not individual values. To group or count by severity, use AssetInsightOnly.severity (insight-only) or AssetDetails_ch.severity (with asset attributes).

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.source_table
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg SourceTable
dimensions.description: Internal source table name for data lineage debugging. Structural dimension for internal tracking.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.providers
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Providers
dimensions.description: All discovery sources/providers for this asset as a JSON array. Use when you need the raw list of all sources. For display-friendly labels, use providers_label. For the single primary provider, see provider.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.source_job_name
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Source
dimensions.description: Name of the discovery job that found this asset. Use when filtering by discovery job or checking which job populated the asset.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.super_category
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Category_old
dimensions.description: Top-level classification of the asset (e.g., "compute", "network", "iot", "storage"). Use when asking 'show assets by category' or high-level grouping. For display, use super_category_label. For finer categories, see categories. For taxonomy-based classification, see taxonomy_super_category.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.super_category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg SuperCategoryLabel
dimensions.description: Capitalized display name for super category (e.g., "Compute", "Network", "Iot"). Prefer this over super_category for display. For the raw value, see super_category.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.system_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg SystemTags
dimensions.description: System-assigned tags as a JSON object. Auto-generated tags set by the platform. For user-defined tags, see user_tags. For merged user and system tags, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.display_type
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg display_type
dimensions.description: Raw asset or resource type identifier in snake_case format (e.g., "aws_ec2_instances", "aws_s3_buckets"). Primarily for internal compatibility. Use when asking about asset types or grouping by resource type. For human-readable categories, prefer categories_label.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.user_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg UserTags
dimensions.description: User-defined tags as a JSON object with key-value pairs. Use when filtering or viewing custom tags applied by users. For system-generated tags, see system_tags. For merged tags, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.vendor
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Vendor
dimensions.description: Hardware or software vendor/manufacturer (e.g., "Cisco", "Dell", "Microsoft"). Use when asking 'show assets by vendor', 'which vendor', or filtering by manufacturer.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.violations
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Violations
dimensions.description: Array of violation flags for each insight on this asset. Primarily for Builder compatibility. All insights in this cube have violated=true since non-violated insights are filtered out.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.created_at
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg FirstSync
dimensions.description: When the asset was first created/discovered in the system. Use when filtering by creation date, e.g., 'assets created in the last 30 days'. For first network observation, see first_seen. For last update, see updated_at.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.updated_at
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LastSync
dimensions.description: When the asset record was last updated in the system. Use when filtering by 'recently updated assets' or sorting by last update time. For last network observation, see last_seen. For creation time, see created_at.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.deleted_at
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg DeleteTime
dimensions.description: When the asset was soft-deleted. Null means the asset is active. Use segments 'existing_assets' or 'removed_assets' instead of filtering this directly. For creation time, see created_at. For last update, see updated_at.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.effective_change_at
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Effective Change At
dimensions.description: Latest lifecycle timestamp for the asset (greatest of created_at, updated_at, deleted_at). Used as the delta sync sort key.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.first_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg FirstSeen
dimensions.description: When the asset was first observed on the network. Use when asking 'when was this asset first seen' or filtering by first seen date. For first system sync time, see created_at.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.last_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LastSeen
dimensions.description: When the asset was last observed on the network. Use when asking 'when was this asset last seen', 'stale assets not seen in 30 days', or filtering by last seen date. For last system update, see updated_at.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.user_count
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg User Count
dimensions.description: Number of distinct users who logged on to this asset in the last 7 days. Use when asking 'how many users logged into this device', 'devices with most users', or sorting by user activity.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.length_categories_old
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LengthOfCategoriesArray
dimensions.description: Count of categories assigned to the asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching with the 'IS EXACTLY' operator.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.length_ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LengthOfIpsArray
dimensions.description: Count of IP addresses on the asset. Used internally for array matching. Can indicate 'assets with multiple IPs'.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.length_cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LengthOfCidrsArray
dimensions.description: Count of CIDR blocks associated with the asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.length_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LengthOfProviderArray
dimensions.description: Count of discovery sources for the asset. Used internally for array matching. Use when asking 'how many providers discovered this asset' or 'assets found by multiple sources'.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.length_secondary_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LengthOfSecondaryProvidersArray
dimensions.description: Count of secondary providers. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.length_mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LengthOfMacAddressesArray
dimensions.description: Count of MAC addresses on the asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.length_insight_types
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LengthOfClassificationArray
dimensions.description: Count of insight classifications for this asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.length_insight_confidence_levels
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LengthOfConfidenceArray
dimensions.description: Count of insight confidence levels for this asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.length_insight_indicator_ids
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LengthOfIndicatorArray
dimensions.description: Count of insight indicators for this asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.length_insight_registration_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LengthOfMissingRecordsArray
dimensions.description: Count of registration indicators for this asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.length_insight_registration_statuses
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LengthOfRegistrationStatusArray
dimensions.description: Count of registration statuses for this asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.length_insight_subclassifications
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LengthOfSubClassificationArray
dimensions.description: Count of insight sub-classifications for this asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Tags
dimensions.description: Merged JSON object of both user-defined and system-generated tags. Use when querying across all tags regardless of source. Filter by tag key name using 'contains' operator. For separate sources, see user_tags and system_tags.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.combined_tags_all_keys
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg TagsKeys
dimensions.description: Distinct list of all tag key names across user and system tags as a JSON array. Use when asking 'what tags are available' or 'list all tag keys'. For values under a specific key, use combined_tags_values_for_a_key.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.combined_tags_values_for_a_key
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg TagsValuesForGivenKey
dimensions.description: Distinct values for a specific tag key as a JSON array. Requires combined_tags filter set to the desired key name. Use when asking 'what are the values for tag X'. For listing all keys, see combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.empty_insight_confidences
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Empty Insight Confidences
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no insight confidence levels. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.empty_insight_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Empty Insight Indicators
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no insight indicators. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.empty_indicator_rule_ids
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Empty Indicator Rule IDs
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no indicator rule IDs. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.empty_insight_registration_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Empty Insight Registration Indicators
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no registration indicators. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.empty_insight_registration_statuses
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Empty Insight Registration Statuses
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no registration statuses. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.empty_insight_sub_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Empty Insight Sub Classifications
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no insight sub-classifications. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.empty_insight_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Empty Insight Classifications
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no insight classifications. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.empty_severities
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Empty Severities
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no insight severities. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.empty_insight_states
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Empty Insight States
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no insight states. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.empty_violations
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Empty Violations
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no violations. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.overall_status
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg OverallStatus
dimensions.description: Overall health and discovery status of the device. Use when asking 'what is the device status' or filtering by overall health.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.reachable_status
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg ReachedStatus
dimensions.description: Whether the device is reachable via network (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking 'is the device reachable', 'unreachable devices', or checking network connectivity.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.snmp_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg SNMPCollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether SNMP collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking 'is SNMP enabled' or 'devices with SNMP on/off'.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.snmp_credential_status
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg SNMPCredentialStatus
dimensions.description: Status of the SNMP credential check (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking 'SNMP credential issues' or filtering by SNMP authentication status.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.snmp_collection_status
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg SNMPCollectionStatus
dimensions.description: Status of SNMP data collection (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking 'SNMP collection issues' or checking if SNMP data was successfully collected.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.cli_credential_status
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg CLICredentialStatus
dimensions.description: Status of CLI (SSH/Telnet) credential validation. Use when checking CLI authentication status across devices.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.cli_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg CLICollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether CLI (SSH/Telnet) collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking 'is CLI collection enabled' or filtering by CLI status.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.finger_print_status
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg FingerPrintStatus
dimensions.description: Status of device fingerprinting for device type identification. Use when checking if device type was successfully identified.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.sdn_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg SDNCollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether SDN collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking 'is SDN enabled' on devices.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.sdn_collection_status
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg SDNCollectionStatus
dimensions.description: Status of SDN (Software Defined Networking) data collection. Use when checking SDN integration status.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.taxonomy_origins
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg taxonomy_origins
dimensions.description: All taxonomy origin classifications as a JSON array (e.g., ["cloud", "on-prem"]). Full list per asset. For grouping or filtering by individual origin, use taxonomy_origin instead.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.taxonomy_origin
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg taxonomy_origin
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy origin (unnested). Values like "cloud", "on-prem". Use when grouping or filtering by origin, e.g., 'show cloud vs on-prem assets'. For the full list per asset, use taxonomy_origins.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.taxonomy_resource_types
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg taxonomy_resource_types
dimensions.description: All taxonomy resource type classifications as a JSON array. Full list per asset. For grouping or filtering by individual resource type, use taxonomy_resource_type instead.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.taxonomy_resource_type
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg taxonomy_resource_type
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy resource type (unnested). Use when grouping or filtering by resource type classification. For the full list per asset, use taxonomy_resource_types.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.taxonomy_super_categories
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Category
dimensions.description: All taxonomy super category classifications as a JSON array (e.g., ["compute", "iot"]). For grouping or filtering by individual value, use taxonomy_super_category. For the simpler single-value classification, see super_category.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.length_categories
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LengthOfTaxonomySuperCategoriesArray
dimensions.description: Count of categories assigned to the asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching with the 'IS EXACTLY' operator.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.taxonomy_super_category
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg taxonomy_super_category
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy super category (unnested). Use when grouping by taxonomy-based super category. Multi-valued from the taxonomy system, unlike super_category. For display, use taxonomy_super_category_label. For the full list, use taxonomy_super_categories.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.taxonomy_super_categories_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg taxonomy_super_categories_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted taxonomy super categories as a JSON array (e.g., ["Compute", "IoT"]). For individual display labels, use taxonomy_super_category_label. For raw values, see taxonomy_super_categories.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.taxonomy_super_category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg taxonomy_super_category_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted individual taxonomy super category (e.g., "IoT", "Compute"). Prefer this over taxonomy_super_category for display. For the full array, see taxonomy_super_categories_label.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.taxonomy_types
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Type
dimensions.description: All taxonomy type classifications as a JSON array. Most granular level of taxonomy. For grouping or filtering by individual type, use taxonomy_type instead.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.length_taxonomy_types
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg LengthOfTaxonomyTypesArray
dimensions.description: Count of taxonomy types assigned to the asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching with the 'IS EXACTLY' operator.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.taxonomy_type
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg taxonomy_type
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy type (unnested). Most specific taxonomy classification. Use when grouping or filtering by the most detailed asset type. For display, use taxonomy_type_label. For the full list, use taxonomy_types.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.taxonomy_types_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg taxonomy_types_labels
dimensions.description: Display-formatted taxonomy types as a JSON array with dictionary lookups. 'Uncategorized' for unknown types. For individual labels, use taxonomy_type_label. For raw values, see taxonomy_types.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.taxonomy_type_label
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg taxonomy_type_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted individual taxonomy type with dictionary lookup. Falls back to raw value or 'Uncategorized'. Prefer this over taxonomy_type for display. For the full array, see taxonomy_types_label.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.taxonomy_path
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg taxonomy_path
dimensions.description: Full taxonomy hierarchy path as a JSON array of 'origin/resource_type/super_category/type' strings (e.g., ["cloud/infrastructure/compute/virtual_machine"]). Use when displaying the complete taxonomy hierarchy.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.os_type
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg OSType
dimensions.description: Type or family of operating system (e.g., "IOS-XE", "Windows", "Linux"). Use when grouping by OS family or filtering by OS type. For the full OS name, see os. For the version number, see os_version.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.os_version
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg OSVersion
dimensions.description: Specific version of the operating system (e.g., "17.3.4", "22.04"). Use when filtering by exact OS version or checking for outdated versions. For the OS family, see os_type. For the full OS name, see os.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.serial_number
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg SerialNumber
dimensions.description: Hardware serial number of the device. Use when looking up a specific device by serial number.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.os_build
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg OSBuild
dimensions.description: Build number or identifier of the operating system (e.g., "22H2", "19045.3086"). Use when filtering by specific OS build or identifying patch levels.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.parent_container_id
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg ParentContainerId

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.os_eos
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg OSEndOfSale
dimensions.description: Date when the OS version reaches End of Support (vendor stops providing updates). Use when asking 'which assets are past end of support' or identifying unsupported OS versions. For end of life, see os_eol. For end of security patches, see os_eossec.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.os_eol
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg OSEndOfLife
dimensions.description: Date when the OS version reaches End of Life (no longer maintained). Use when asking 'which assets are end of life', 'EOL devices', or identifying fully retired OS versions. For end of support, see os_eos. For end of security patches, see os_eossec.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.os_eossec
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg OSEndOfSecuritySupport
dimensions.description: Date when security patches stop for this OS version. Use when asking 'which assets won't receive security patches' or assessing security risk from outdated OS. For end of support, see os_eos. For end of life, see os_eol.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.os_release_date
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg OSReleaseDate
dimensions.description: When this OS version was originally released. Use when asking 'how old is this OS version' or checking release timeline. For latest available version date, see os_latest_version_date.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.os_latest_version_date
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg OSLatestVersionDate
dimensions.description: Date of the latest available version for this OS family. Use when comparing current version age against the latest available update. For the original release date, see os_release_date.

dimensions.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.logon_user_names
dimensions.title: Asset Details Ch Agg UseridToUserNameMap
dimensions.description: Map of logon user IDs to user names as a JSON object. Use when displaying which users logged into an asset along with their display names.

measures.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.count
measures.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Count
measures.description: Total number of asset rows. In this aggregated cube each asset produces one row, so this equals the asset count. Use when asking 'how many assets' or 'total count'. For a deduplicated count by unique identifier, use assetsCount. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.assetsCount
measures.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Assets Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets (unique CQIDs). Each asset is counted once regardless of grouping. Use when asking 'how many assets', 'how many devices', or 'asset count'. Prefer this over count for deduplicated totals. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insightsCount
measures.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Insights Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets that have at least one security insight or violation. Use when asking 'how many assets have insights', 'assets with issues', or 'assets with violations'. Unlike assetsCount which counts all assets, this only includes those with active insight sub-classifications.

measures.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.percent
measures.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Percent
measures.description: Percentage of rows relative to the total result set. Use when asking 'what percentage of total' for row-level breakdowns. For percentage of unique assets, use assetsPercent. For percentage of assets with insights, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.assetsPercent
measures.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Assets Percent
measures.description: Percentage of unique assets relative to total unique assets in the result. Use when asking 'what percentage of assets', 'asset distribution', or 'share of assets' grouped by a dimension. For row-level percentages, use percent. For insight-specific percentages, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.insightsPercent
measures.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Insights Percent
measures.description: Percentage of assets-with-insights relative to total assets-with-insights. Use when asking 'what percentage of insights' or 'insight distribution' grouped by a dimension. For general asset percentages, use assetsPercent instead.

segments.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.asset_insights
segments.title: Asset Details Ch Agg Asset Insights
segments.description: Only assets that have at least one insight sub-classification. Use when the user wants to focus on assets with security insights.

segments.name: AssetDetails_ch_agg.existing_assets

full.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus
full.title: Asset Discovery Status
full.description: Device discovery-status cube with one row per asset. Exposes discovery and network collection health fields such as device IP/name/type, reachability results, SNMP or CLI or SDN credential and collection statuses, fingerprinting outcomes, discovery timestamps, overall status, discovery service identifiers, and device-type confidence signals. Use this cube when a query focuses on operational discovery health rather than general asset inventory or insight analytics, for example "show unreachable devices by type", "list assets with failed SNMP credentials", "find devices with low type-identification confidence", or "track SDN collection failures by source job". Prefer this cube over broader asset cube when the question is primarily about discovery workflow status because it keeps the surface focused on discovery-specific fields.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status AccountId
dimensions.description: Tenant or customer account identifier. Automatically filtered by security context. Rarely needed in queries directly.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.cqid
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status CQID
dimensions.description: Unique CloudQuery identifier for each asset/device. Use when filtering or looking up a specific asset by its ID (CQID).

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.composite_id
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status CompositeID
dimensions.description: Composite key combining account_id and cqid. Used internally for row uniqueness. Rarely needed in user queries.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.device_ip_dotted
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status IPAddress
dimensions.description: Primary IP address of the device in dotted notation (e.g., "192.168.1.1"). Use when displaying a single IP for the device in tables or detail views.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.device_name
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status DeviceName
dimensions.description: Name or hostname of the network device. Use when searching or displaying the device name in discovery context.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.device_type
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status DeviceType
dimensions.description: Type classification of the network device (e.g., "Router", "Switch", "Firewall"). Use when asking "what type of device" or grouping by device type in discovery context.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.reachable_status
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status ReachedStatus
dimensions.description: Whether the device is reachable via network (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking "is the device reachable", "unreachable devices", or checking network connectivity.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.reachable_message
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status ReachedMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message explaining the reachability status. Use when drilling down into why a device is unreachable.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.snmp_credential_status
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status SNMPCredentialStatus
dimensions.description: Status of the SNMP credential check (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking "SNMP credential issues" or filtering by SNMP authentication status.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.snmp_credential_message
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status SNMPCredentialMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message explaining the SNMP credential status. Use when debugging SNMP credential failures.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.snmp_collection_status
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status SNMPCollectionStatus
dimensions.description: Status of SNMP data collection (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking "SNMP collection issues" or checking if SNMP data was successfully collected.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.snmp_collection_message
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status SNMPCollectionMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about SNMP collection status. Use when debugging SNMP collection failures.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.cli_credential_status
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status CLICredentialStatus
dimensions.description: Status of CLI (SSH/Telnet) credential validation. Use when checking CLI authentication status across devices.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.cli_credential_message
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status CLICredentialMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about CLI credential status. Use when debugging CLI access failures.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.finger_print_status
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status FingerPrintStatus
dimensions.description: Status of device fingerprinting (device type identification). Use when checking if device type was successfully identified.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.finger_print_message
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status FingerPrintMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about device fingerprinting status.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.sdn_collection_status
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status SDNCollectionStatus
dimensions.description: Status of SDN (Software Defined Networking) data collection. Use when checking SDN integration status.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.sdn_collection_message
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status SDNCollectionMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about SDN collection status.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.updated_time
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status LastUpdate
dimensions.description: When the device discovery status was last updated. Use when asking "when was this device last updated" or sorting devices by most recent update.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.device_first_occurrence_time
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status FirstSeen
dimensions.description: When this device was first discovered on the network. Use when asking "when was this device first found" or filtering by discovery date.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.last_action
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status LastAction
dimensions.description: Most recent action performed on or by the device (e.g., discovery scan, configuration change). Use when checking the last activity on a device.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.discovery_status_last_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status DiscoveryLastSeen
dimensions.description: When the discovery service last observed this device. Use when asking "when was this device last seen by discovery" or finding stale/offline devices.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.app_infra_service_id
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status DiscoveryService
dimensions.description: Identifier of the discovery service/appliance that manages this device. Use when filtering by discovery service or finding devices managed by a specific service.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.overall_status
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status OverallStatus
dimensions.description: Overall health/discovery status of the device. Use when asking "what is the device status" or filtering by overall health.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.snmp_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status SNMPCollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether SNMP collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking "is SNMP enabled", "devices with SNMP on/off".

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.cli_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status CLICollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether CLI (SSH/Telnet) collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking "is CLI collection enabled" or filtering by CLI status.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.sdn_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status SDNCollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether SDN collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking "is SDN enabled" on devices.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.device_support
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status DeviceSupport
dimensions.description: Level of discovery support for the device (e.g., "Basic", "Advanced"). Use when asking about the device support tier or filtering devices by their discovery support level.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.super_category
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status Category
dimensions.description: Top-level classification of the asset (e.g., "compute", "network", "iot", "storage"). Use when filtering by super category.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.updated_at
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status UpdatedAt
dimensions.description: When this asset record was last updated. Use when filtering or sorting assets by most recent update timestamp.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.created_at
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status CreatedAt
dimensions.description: When this asset record was first created. Use when filtering by asset creation date or finding newly added assets.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.device_assurance
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status Device Assurance
dimensions.description: Numerical confidence score (0-100) for device type identification accuracy. Higher values mean higher confidence. Used to derive type_probability.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.type_probability
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status TypeProbability
dimensions.description: Confidence category for device type identification: LOW (0-20), MEDIUM (21-74), HIGH (75-100). Use when asking "how confident is the device type", "show low-confidence devices", or grouping by type identification confidence.

dimensions.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.source_job_name
dimensions.title: Asset Discovery Status SourceJobName
dimensions.description: Name of the discovery job that last reported this asset. Use when filtering or displaying which job sourced the device data.

measures.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.count
measures.title: Asset Discovery Status Count
measures.description: Total number of device rows. Each device produces one row. Use when asking "how many devices" or "total count".

measures.name: AssetDiscoveryStatus.assetsCount
measures.title: Asset Discovery Status Assets Count
measures.description: Number of distinct devices (unique CQIDs). Use when asking "how many devices" or "device count".

full.name: AssetInsight
full.title: Asset Insight
full.description: Security and compliance insight cube enriched with dictionary labels for insight type, indicator, and location. Grain is detailed and time-aware: rows represent indicator/rule findings per asset over time windows, with latest values selected per grouped keys in the query logic. Use this cube for insight-centric analysis such as "show active violations by severity", "list findings by indicator and provider", "track acknowledged vs unacknowledged insights", or "break down insights by asset type/location". Prefer this cube when the question is primarily about insight lifecycle, confidence, severity, and violation state. Do NOT use this cube for broad asset inventory fields (tags, reconciliation, interface details, provider raw JSON).

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.tenant_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Tenant Id
dimensions.description: Internal tenant identifier supporting MSP multi-tenant access, automatically filtered by the platform's security context. Maps to the same underlying value as account_id. Use when asking about tenant-level insight breakdowns.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.tenant_id_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Type of Tenant Id
dimensions.description: Type of tenant identifier used for account resolution. Possible value account_uuid. Primarily for internal compatibility. Use when asking about the tenant identifier format.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Account ID
dimensions.description: Internal tenant or customer account identifier, automatically filtered by the platform's security context. Maps to the same underlying value as tenant_id. Use when filtering or grouping insights by customer account.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.csp_account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Csp Account ID
dimensions.description: Cloud provider account ID (e.g., AWS account ID, Azure subscription) associated with the asset. Use when filtering by "cloud account", "AWS account", or grouping insights by their cloud provider account.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.insight_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Insight Type
dimensions.description: Raw insight classification code (e.g., "registration", "security") indicating the broad category of the finding. For display, prefer insight_type_label. Use when filtering by insight type programmatically.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.insight_type_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Insight Type Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable label for the insight type classification. Falls back to raw insight_type or "Uncategorized". Prefer over insight_type for display and grouping. Use when asking "what type of insight" or grouping by insight type.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.indicator_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Indicator ID
dimensions.description: Unique identifier of the insight indicator (e.g., a specific compliance check or security finding). For display, prefer indicator_id_label. Use when filtering by a specific indicator programmatically.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.indicator_id_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Indicator ID Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable label for the insight indicator. Falls back to raw indicator_id or "Uncategorized". Prefer over indicator_id for display. Use when asking "which indicator", "show findings by indicator", or displaying indicator names.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.indicator_rule_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Indicator Rule ID
dimensions.description: Unique ID of the specific rule variant that triggered this insight finding. A single indicator may have multiple rule variants for different asset types. Use when filtering to a specific insight rule.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.provider
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Provider
dimensions.description: Discovery source or cloud provider that reported the insight (e.g., "aws", "azure", "gcp", "nios", "servicenow"). For display, prefer provider_label. For the asset's own cloud provider, use asset_provider instead. Use when filtering insights by source.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.provider_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Provider Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable provider name with proper casing (e.g., "AWS", "GCP", "Azure", "ServiceNow"). Prefer over provider for display. Represents the insight source, not the asset's cloud provider - use asset_provider for that. Use when displaying or grouping by provider.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.asset_cqid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Asset Cqid
dimensions.description: Unique CloudQuery identifier (CQID) for the asset associated with this insight. Internal primary key for row-level uniqueness. Use when filtering or looking up insights for a specific asset by its ID.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.asset_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Asset Name
dimensions.description: Display name or hostname of the asset associated with this insight. Use when searching for insights by asset name or displaying the asset identity alongside findings.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.asset_categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Asset Categories
dimensions.description: All categories of the associated asset as a JSON array string, describing the asset's functional classification. Use when asking about asset categories alongside insight data.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.asset_location
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Asset Location
dimensions.description: Raw cloud region or location string of the associated asset. For a human-friendly location name, prefer location_label. Use when filtering insights by raw location or region code.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.location_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Location Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable location name derived from provider and region (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Falls back to raw location or "Global". Prefer over asset_location for display. Use when asking "where is the asset located" or grouping by location.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.asset_provider
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Asset Provider
dimensions.description: Cloud provider of the associated asset, which may differ from the insight provider. For the insight reporting source, use provider instead. Use when filtering insights by the asset's own cloud provider.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.asset_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Asset Type
dimensions.description: Resource type of the associated asset (e.g., "EC2 Instance", "Virtual Machine"). Use when asking "what type of asset has this insight" or grouping insights by asset type.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.asset_ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Asset Ip Addresses
dimensions.description: IP addresses of the associated asset. Use when searching insights by IP address, correlating findings with network addresses, or displaying network information alongside insight data.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.state
dimensions.title: Asset Insight State
dimensions.description: Current lifecycle state of the insight (e.g., "active", "acknowledged"). Use when filtering by "active insights", "acknowledged insights", or asking about the insight lifecycle state.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.ack_user_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Ack User ID
dimensions.description: User ID of the person who acknowledged this insight. Use when asking "who acknowledged this insight" or filtering insights by the acknowledging user.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.confidence_level
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Confidence Level
dimensions.description: Raw confidence level of the insight finding (e.g., "low", "medium", "high"), reflecting system certainty the finding is valid. For display, prefer confidence_level_label. Use when filtering by confidence programmatically.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.confidence_level_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Confidence Level Label
dimensions.description: Capitalized display name for confidence level (e.g., "Low", "Medium", "High"). Prefer over confidence_level for display. Use when displaying confidence to users or grouping insights by confidence level.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.severity
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Severity
dimensions.description: Severity level of the insight (e.g., "critical", "high", "medium", "low"), reflecting potential impact if not addressed. Use when asking "show critical insights", "filter by severity", or grouping insights by severity.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.violated
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Violated
dimensions.description: Whether the insight rule is currently violated (true/false). Active violations indicate an ongoing security or compliance issue. Use when filtering for violated or non-violated findings.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.asset_last_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Asset Last Seen
dimensions.description: When the associated asset was last seen by the discovery system. Data is filtered to assets seen within the last 14 days. sync_time is an alias for this field. Use when asking "when was this asset last seen" or filtering by recency.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.sync_time
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Sync Time
dimensions.description: Alias for asset_last_seen, representing the last synchronization time of the asset data. For the canonical field name, use asset_last_seen. Use when filtering or sorting by data freshness.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.evaluation_time
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Evaluation Time
dimensions.description: When the insight was last evaluated by the policy engine. Use when asking "when was this insight evaluated", filtering by evaluation date, or sorting by most recently evaluated findings.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.ack_time
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Ack Time
dimensions.description: When the insight was acknowledged by a user. Use when asking "when was this acknowledged", filtering by acknowledgment date, or sorting by acknowledgment recency.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.ack_until_time
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Ack Until Time
dimensions.description: Expiration time of the acknowledgment. After this time the insight becomes active again. Use when asking "when does the acknowledgment expire" or finding insights with expiring acknowledgments.

dimensions.name: AssetInsight.asset_managed
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Managed/Unmanaged
dimensions.description: Whether the associated asset is managed (true) or unmanaged (false). Use when asking "show insights for managed assets", "unmanaged device insights", or filtering by management status.

measures.name: AssetInsight.count
measures.title: Asset Insight Count
measures.description: Count of unique assets (by CQID) matching the current filters. Use when asking "how many assets have insights", "count of assets with violations", or any question needing a distinct asset count.

full.name: AssetInsightOnly
full.title: Asset Insight Only
full.description: Insight-only cube combining active insight rows with minimal asset status context. Grain is one row per active insight per asset, so a single asset can produce multiple rows when it has multiple active findings. Each row exposes the per-insight fields needed for security analysis, including classification, indicator, rule ID, state, confidence, severity, sub-classification, and sync timestamps, plus managed status for basic asset scoping. Use this cube when the question is about insight behaviour itself rather than broader asset inventory, for example "show active insights by severity", "count registration findings by confidence", or "list assets with a specific indicator rule". Choose this cube or AssetDetails_ch over AssetDetails_ch_agg whenever the query groups by, breaks down by, or counts WITHIN any insight dimension — classification, sub-classification, indicator, indicator rule, confidence, severity, or state — because in both each insight is its own row and these are groupable scalar dimensions; in AssetDetails_ch_agg those same fields are per-asset arrays and cannot be grouped correctly. Use THIS cube when the breakdown is purely by insight dimensions with little or no asset attributes (e.g. "zombie assets by sub-classification", "breakdown of insights by severity"); use AssetDetails_ch when the same query also groups by or returns asset attributes such as provider, OS, region, or vendor (e.g. "violated insights by provider and severity"). For asset inventory with rolled-up insight arrays — one row per asset, insight fields used only for filtering — use AssetDetails_ch_agg. Time dimension: default to updated_at (insight sync time) scoped to the last 7 days from now (to the minute); if the user specifies a time range — for example "in the last 3 hours", "over the past 2 days", or "not in the last 3 days" — apply those constraints instead, as user-specified time always takes priority over the default.

full.name: AssetProviderData
full.title: Asset Provider Data
full.description: Provider-data comparison cube combining raw provider-specific rows with a synthetic common row derived from aggregated asset data for each asset. Grain is one row per asset-provider-source record, plus one additional common row per asset that represents the merged asset view. Each row exposes provider-reported attributes such as provider identity, source table, raw JSON payload, sync time, name, OS and version, vendor, model, serial number, IP or MAC addresses, location, tags, and provider-specific first or last seen timestamps. Use this cube when a query needs provider-level differences or raw provider payloads, for example "compare device names across providers", "show raw provider JSON for this asset", "find which provider last saw an asset", or "review OS and serial mismatches between common and provider rows". Prefer this cube over broader asset cube when the question is specifically about per-provider provenance, disagreement, or raw source data.

full.name: AssetProviderDataAttrIndex
full.title: Asset Provider Data Attr Index
full.description: Flattened attribute search index over provider raw JSON. Grain is one row per distinct (account, provider, source_table, json_path, value) tuple — deduplicated, so a value shared by many assets collapses to a single row (asset identity is intentionally not part of the grain). Each row exposes the JSON path, its original ClickHouse datatype, and the value cast to String. Use this cube to power attribute search and value autocomplete, for example "list the distinct json paths a provider reports", "suggest values for json_path 'Architecture'", or "find paths whose name contains 'launch'". Backed by ngrams(3) full-text indexes on provider, source_table and json_path, so substring search on those columns is granule-accelerated. The columns form a cascading drill-down hierarchy — provider → source_table → json_path → value — so narrow filters left-to-right (pick a provider, then a source_table, then a json_path) before suggesting values. For per-asset raw payloads or provider provenance use AssetProviderData instead; this cube is a distinct-attribute catalog, not a per-asset table.

dimensions.name: AssetProviderDataAttrIndex.account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Provider Data Attr Index AccountId
dimensions.description: BloxOne account identifier. Automatically filtered to the current user's account via security context.

dimensions.name: AssetProviderDataAttrIndex.provider
dimensions.title: Asset Provider Data Attr Index Provider
dimensions.description: Discovery source or cloud provider that reported the attribute (e.g. "AWS", "GCP"). Backed by an ngrams(3) full-text index, so pass a hasPhrase(provider, 'term') expression for granule-accelerated case-insensitive substring search. Use provider_label for display. Note: for an all-single-provider tenant this dimension is non-discriminating.

dimensions.name: AssetProviderDataAttrIndex.provider_label
dimensions.title: Asset Provider Data Attr Index ProviderLabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable provider name with proper casing. Use for display instead of the raw provider value.

dimensions.name: AssetProviderDataAttrIndex.source_table
dimensions.title: Asset Provider Data Attr Index SourceTable
dimensions.description: Provider resource/source table the attribute came from (e.g. "aws_ec2_instances", "aws_s3_buckets"). Backed by an ngrams(3) full-text index, so pass a hasPhrase(source_table, 'term') expression for granule-accelerated case-insensitive substring search. Use when scoping search to a resource type or grouping attributes by source.

dimensions.name: AssetProviderDataAttrIndex.json_path
dimensions.title: Asset Provider Data Attr Index JsonPath
dimensions.description: Dot-delimited path of the attribute within the provider raw JSON (e.g. "Architecture", "Tags.Env"). Backed by an ngrams(3) full-text index, so pass a hasPhrase(json_path, 'term') expression for granule-accelerated case-insensitive substring search. Use when listing or searching attribute names; pair with the value dimension for autocomplete.

dimensions.name: AssetProviderDataAttrIndex.datatype
dimensions.title: Asset Provider Data Attr Index DataType
dimensions.description: Original ClickHouse type of the JSON value before it was cast to String (e.g. "String", "Int64", "Float64", "Bool"). Use when you need to interpret or cast the value back to its native type, or to filter to a specific value kind.

dimensions.name: AssetProviderDataAttrIndex.value
dimensions.title: Asset Provider Data Attr Index Value
dimensions.description: Attribute value cast to String for uniform filtering. Cast back using datatype when a native type is needed. Use for value autocomplete/suggestions, typically with a json_path filter. There is no full-text index on value, so prefer an exact value filter or scope by account/json_path first.

dimensions.name: AssetProviderDataAttrIndex.updated_at
dimensions.title: Asset Provider Data Attr Index UpdatedAt
dimensions.description: When the path/value was last seen during sync. Rows expire 7 days after this time via TTL. Use when filtering attributes by recency.

measures.name: AssetProviderDataAttrIndex.count
measures.title: Asset Provider Data Attr Index Count
measures.description: Total number of attribute rows (distinct path/value tuples after dedup) matching the filters. Use for "how many attributes/values" questions. For distinct value or path counts, use distinct_values or distinct_paths.

measures.name: AssetProviderDataAttrIndex.distinct_values
measures.title: Asset Provider Data Attr Index Distinct Values
measures.description: Number of distinct values across the matching rows. Use when asking how many unique values a path or provider has. Typically paired with a json_path filter, e.g. distinct values of 'InstanceType'.

measures.name: AssetProviderDataAttrIndex.distinct_paths
measures.title: Asset Provider Data Attr Index Distinct Paths
measures.description: Number of distinct JSON paths across the matching rows. Use when asking how many distinct attributes a provider or source_table exposes.
