full.description: Lookup table mapping insight sub-classification codes to display labels, with one row per sub-classification. Sub-classifications use a "parent/child" path hierarchy across three types - zombie (e.g., "zombie/stale_device" -> "Stale Device"), compliance (e.g., "compliance/missing_patch" -> "Missing Patch"), and ghost (e.g., "ghost/discovery_gap" -> "Discovery Gap"). Use for questions about available sub-classifications, populating filter dropdowns, or resolving codes to friendly names. Supports filtering by zombie, compliance, and ghost insight types via segments. Joined by other asset cubes for sub-classification lookups - contains no measures. Example queries: "what sub-classifications exist", "list all zombie sub-types", "show compliance insight categories".

dimensions.name: AssetSubClassifications.subclassification
dimensions.title: Asset Sub Classifications Subclassification
dimensions.description: Short key identifying the insight sub-classification (e.g., "stale_device", "missing_patch", "discovery_gap"). Primary key for this lookup cube. Functionally equivalent to insight_subclassification_key. Use when joining to other cubes by sub-classification code. For the full hierarchical path, use insight_subclassification. For the display name, use label.

dimensions.name: AssetSubClassifications.insight_subclassification
dimensions.title: Asset Sub Classifications Insight Subclassification
dimensions.description: Full hierarchical insight sub-classification path (e.g., "zombie/stale_device", "compliance/missing_patch", "ghost/discovery_gap"). Use when filtering or grouping by the complete classification and sub-type. For only the sub-type key, use subclassification or insight_subclassification_key instead.

dimensions.name: AssetSubClassifications.insight_subclassification_key
dimensions.title: Asset Sub Classifications Insight Subclassification Key
dimensions.description: Lowercased sub-type key extracted from the hierarchical path (second segment after '/'). Functionally equivalent to subclassification. Use when grouping by the specific sub-type without the parent classification prefix. For the full path, use insight_subclassification.

dimensions.name: AssetSubClassifications.label
dimensions.title: Asset Sub Classifications Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable display name for the sub-classification. Use when asking "what sub-classifications are available", listing sub-classification names in dropdowns, or displaying to users. For the raw code identifier, use subclassification instead.

segments.name: AssetSubClassifications.zombie
segments.title: Asset Sub Classifications Zombie
segments.description: Only sub-classifications under the "zombie" category (e.g., stale or inactive assets). Use when listing zombie-type insight sub-classifications.

segments.name: AssetSubClassifications.compliance
segments.title: Asset Sub Classifications Compliance
segments.description: Only sub-classifications under the "compliance" category. Use when listing compliance-related insight sub-classifications.

segments.name: AssetSubClassifications.ghost
segments.title: Asset Sub Classifications Ghost
segments.description: Only sub-classifications under the "ghost" category (e.g., assets found by one source but missing from another). Use when listing ghost-type insight sub-classifications.

dimensions.name: AssetSuperCategories.name
dimensions.title: Asset Super Categories Name

full.name: AssetSuperCategories
full.title: Asset Super Categories
full.description: Static lookup table enumerating top-level asset categories (Devices, Network, Services, Unverified). One row per category. Each represents a high-level grouping: "Devices" covers servers, workstations, laptops, IP phones, media devices, and power devices; "Network" covers routers, switches, firewalls, gateways, load balancers, subnets, and wireless controllers; "Services" covers DNS servers, storage, cloud services, and SaaS resources; "Unverified" covers ghost assets detected by one source but not confirmed by another. Use for questions like "what categories exist" or "list top-level asset groupings". Supports populating category filter dropdowns and validating category values. Example queries: "what categories exist", "list top-level asset groupings", "how many network devices do I have", "show all unverified assets".

dimensions.name: AssetSuperCategories.name
dimensions.title: Asset Super Categories Name
dimensions.description: Top-level asset classification (e.g., "Devices", "Network", "Services", "Unverified"). Use when listing super categories or populating a super category dropdown for users.

dimensions.name: AssetTypeLabels.resource
dimensions.title: Types Resource

dimensions.name: AssetTypeLabels.resource_name
dimensions.title: Types Resource Name

segments.name: AssetTypeLabels.onlyAssetTypes
segments.title: Types Only Asset Types

full.name: AssetTypeLabels
full.title: Types
full.description: Dimension-only lookup cube mapping raw cloud resource type identifiers to human-readable display names, one row per resource type. Use for questions about what asset resource types exist, listing resource types, populating resource type filter dropdowns, or resolving resource codes to friendly names. Supports filtering by resource type code or display name. Use when asking "what asset resource types exist", "list resource types", or "show available resource types".

dimensions.name: AssetTypeLabels.resource
dimensions.title: Types Resource
dimensions.description: Raw cloud resource type identifier (e.g., "aws_ec2_instances", "azure_compute_virtual_machines"). Use when joining or filtering by the internal resource type code. Prefer "resource_name" for display.

dimensions.name: AssetTypeLabels.resource_name
dimensions.title: Types Resource Name
dimensions.description: Human-readable display name for the resource type (e.g., "EC2 Instances", "Virtual Machines"). Falls back to raw resource ID or "Uncategorized". Use when asking "what types are available", listing type names, or displaying resource types to users.

segments.name: AssetTypeLabels.onlyAssetTypes
segments.title: Types Only Asset Types
segments.description: Excludes attribute/sub-resource types (e.g., AWS route tables, Azure extensions, K8s pods) to show only primary asset types. Apply by default when listing user-facing asset types.

full.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded
full.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded
full.description: Join cube combining normalised asset attributes with network interface data. Each row represents one asset and exposes: (1) common asset fields -- name, OS, vendor, model, IP/MAC addresses, categories, location, managed status, first/last seen, tags, and source table; (2) aggregated security insights -- insight types, indicator IDs, confidence levels, severities, states, sub-classifications, and pre-computed composite keys like insight_types_confidence_levels; and (3) network interface attributes -- interface details like VRF names, IP addresses, MAC addresses, etc. Use this cube when a query needs BOTH common asset attributes AND network interface attributes -- for example "show me assets with specific interface configurations", "list devices with their network interfaces", or "filter assets by interface properties". Do NOT use this cube for insight-only or asset-only queries where interface data is not needed; prefer AssetDetails_ch_agg for those cases.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded AccountId
dimensions.description: Internal tenant account identifier, automatically filtered by the platform's security context. Use when tenant-level filtering is needed. See cqid for the asset identifier.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.cqid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded CQID
dimensions.description: Unique asset identifier assigned during discovery. Use when filtering or looking up a specific asset by its ID (CQID). See composite_id for the compound row-uniqueness key.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.composite_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded CompositeID
dimensions.description: Composite key combining account_id and cqid, used as the internal primary key for row-level uniqueness. Use when a unique row identifier is needed. See cqid for the standalone asset identifier.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Type_old
dimensions.description: All asset categories as a JSON array. One asset may belong to multiple categories. Use when asking about 'asset types' or 'categories'. For human-readable names, use categories_label. For high-level grouping, use super_category instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.categories_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Type Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable display names for asset categories as a JSON array. Prefer this over categories for display. Use when the user refers to categories by friendly name. For raw category values, see categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded CIDR
dimensions.description: Network CIDR blocks associated with the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about 'network ranges', 'subnets', or 'CIDR blocks' of an asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.cloud_account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded CloudAccountID
dimensions.description: Cloud provider account ID (e.g., AWS account ID, Azure subscription). Use when filtering by 'cloud account', 'AWS account', or grouping assets by their cloud account.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.context
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Location Type
dimensions.description: Discovery context indicating the asset's deployment environment (e.g., on-prem, cloud). Use when asking about 'location type' or filtering cloud vs on-premises assets. For geographic region details, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.dhcp_fingerprint
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded DHCPFingerprint
dimensions.description: DHCP fingerprint string used for network-level device identification. Use when asking about 'DHCP fingerprint' or 'device fingerprinting'.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.discovery_host
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded OPHID
dimensions.description: Display name of the on-premises discovery host that found this asset. For the unique on-prem host identifier, use ophid instead. Primarily for internal reference.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.indicator_rule_ids
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded IndicatorRuleID
dimensions.description: Array of insight indicator rule IDs that triggered findings for this asset. Used for programmatic filtering of specific insight rules. For indicator identifiers, use insight_indicators; for display names, use insight_indicators_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insight_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Classifications
dimensions.description: Distinct insight classifications for this asset as a JSON array (e.g., ["registration", "security"]). Use when asking 'what types of insights' or grouping by insight classification. For display names, use insight_classifications_label. For finer detail, see insight_sub_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insight_classifications_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Classifications Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight classifications as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_classifications for display. Use when the user asks about insight types by friendly name. For raw values, see insight_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insight_confidences
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Confidence
dimensions.description: Array of confidence levels for all insights on this asset (e.g., ["high", "medium"]). Use when asking about insight confidence levels or filtering assets by confidence. For display labels, use insight_confidences_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insight_confidences_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded InsightConfidenceslabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight confidence levels as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_confidences for display. For raw confidence values used in filtering, see insight_confidences.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insight_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Indicator
dimensions.description: Array of insight indicator IDs for this asset. Each indicator represents a specific security check that was triggered. Use when asking 'which indicators' or filtering by indicator. For display names, use insight_indicators_label. For rule definitions, see indicator_rule_ids.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insight_indicators_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded InsightIndicatorslabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight indicators as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_indicators for display. For raw indicator IDs used in filtering, see insight_indicators.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded MissingRecords
dimensions.description: Array of distinct registration-type insight indicators identifying missing records or registration issues. Use when asking 'what registration indicators' or 'missing records'. For display labels, use insight_registration_indicators_label. For registration status, see insight_registration_statuses.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_indicators_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded RegistrationIndicatorslabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for registration indicators as a JSON array. Prefer this for display when showing missing records by friendly name. For raw indicator IDs, see insight_registration_indicators.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_statuses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded RegistrationStatus
dimensions.description: Array of distinct registration statuses for this asset (e.g., ["registered"], ["unregistered"]). Use when asking 'is the asset registered' or 'show unregistered assets'. For display labels, use insight_registration_statuses_label. For which rules triggered, see insight_registration_indicators.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_statuses_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Registration Statuses Label
dimensions.description: Capitalized display labels for registration statuses (e.g., ["Registered"], ["Unregistered"]). Prefer this over insight_registration_statuses for display. For raw status values, see insight_registration_statuses.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insight_states
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded InsightStates
dimensions.description: Array of insight states (e.g., ["active", "none"]). Primarily for Builder compatibility. For filtering by insight type, prefer insight_classifications or insight_sub_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insight_sub_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded SubClassifications
dimensions.description: Array of insight sub-classifications providing finer detail within a classification. Use when drilling into specific insight types or filtering by sub-classification. For display labels, use insight_sub_classifications_label. For broader grouping, see insight_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insight_sub_classifications_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded SubClassifications Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight sub-classifications as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_sub_classifications for display. For raw sub-classification values, see insight_sub_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded IPAddresses
dimensions.description: All IP addresses of the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about an asset's IP addresses or displaying the full list of IPs.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.ips_for_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Ips for Filter
dimensions.description: Internal dimension for filter pushdown optimization on IP addresses. Used by the query builder infrastructure for efficient IP-based filtering.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.location
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded AssetLocation
dimensions.description: Raw location string of the asset. Primarily for Builder compatibility. For human-readable location, use provider_region_label instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded MACAddresses
dimensions.description: All MAC addresses of the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about 'MAC addresses' or displaying hardware network identifiers per asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.managed
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Managed
dimensions.description: Whether the asset is managed (true) or unmanaged (false). Use when asking 'show managed assets', 'unmanaged devices', or filtering by management status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.model
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Model
dimensions.description: Hardware model of the asset/device (e.g., "Cisco ISR 4331"). Use when asking about 'device model', 'hardware model', or grouping by model.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Name
dimensions.description: Display name or hostname of the asset. Use when searching by name, e.g., 'find asset named X', or when displaying asset details.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.ophid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded DiscoveryHost
dimensions.description: On-Prem Host ID, the unique identifier of the on-premises host or appliance associated with this asset. Use when filtering by OPHID or looking up assets tied to a specific on-prem host. For the display name, see discovery_host.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.os
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded OperatingSystem
dimensions.description: Operating system name of the asset (e.g., "Windows 10", "Ubuntu 22.04", "IOS-XE"). Use when asking 'what OS' or filtering by operating system. For the OS family, see os_type. For the version number, see os_version.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.perspective_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded PerspectiveTags
dimensions.description: All perspective tags for the asset as a JSON array. Use when querying perspective-level tag classifications. For user-defined or system tags, see combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.provider

dimensions.description: Primary discovery source or cloud provider (e.g., "aws", "azure", "gcp", "nios", "servicenow"). Raw internal value. For display, use provider_label. For all sources including secondary, use providers.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.provider_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded ProviderLabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable provider name with proper casing (e.g., "AWS", "GCP", "Azure", "ServiceNow"). Prefer this over provider for display. For the raw value, see provider. For all sources, use providers_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.providers_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: All discovery providers for this asset as a formatted JSON array with proper casing. Use when displaying the full list of sources. For raw source values, see providers. For the single primary provider, see provider_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.providers_label_iterator
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: Each source/provider unnested into individual rows with display labels. An asset discovered by 3 providers produces 3 rows. Use when grouping or filtering by all sources. For raw values, use providers_iterator. For primary source only, use provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.provider_region_label_old
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded ProviderandLocationlabel_old
dimensions.description: Legacy format of provider+region label (e.g., "AWS: us-east-1"). Used internally by provider_region_label. Prefer provider_region_label for current region display.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.provider_region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Location_label
dimensions.description: Human-readable region label (e.g., "AWS US East (N. Virginia)", "Unassigned"). Use when asking 'which region', 'show assets by region', or displaying location. For raw region codes, see provider_region.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.provider_region
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Location
dimensions.description: Raw provider region code (e.g., "us-east-1", "westus2"). Use when filtering by exact region code. For display-friendly version, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.provider_label_filter_based
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Providerlabelfromfilter
dimensions.description: Provider label derived from the reconciliation filter value. Used internally by the reconciliation dimension for formatting. For provider display names, use provider_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.reconciliation
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Reconciliation
dimensions.description: Cross-source reconciliation status for a given provider filter. Values: 'Matching' (found in selected provider and others), 'Missing From X', 'Only in X'. Use when asking 'which assets are missing from AWS' or 'reconciliation report'. Requires reconciliation_filter to be set.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.reconciliation_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Reconciliationfilter
dimensions.description: Filter dimension to select which provider to reconcile against (e.g., "aws"). Set this filter to enable reconciliation analysis via the reconciliation dimension.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.region
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Region
dimensions.description: Raw cloud region code. Primarily for Builder compatibility. Prefer provider_region for region filtering and provider_region_label for display.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Region Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable cloud region label (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Primarily for Builder compatibility. Prefer provider_region_label for region display.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.resource
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Resource
dimensions.description: Full raw asset record as a JSON string. Primarily for Builder compatibility. Use when the user wants to inspect the complete raw asset payload.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.secondary_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded SecondaryProviders
dimensions.description: Additional discovery sources beyond the primary provider as a JSON array. Primarily for Builder compatibility. For the complete list of all sources, use providers instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.severities
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Severity
dimensions.description: Array of insight severity levels for this asset. Primarily for Builder compatibility. Values include "critical", "high", "medium", "low".

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.source_table
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded SourceTable
dimensions.description: Internal source table name for data lineage debugging. Structural dimension for internal tracking.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Providers
dimensions.description: All discovery sources/providers for this asset as a JSON array. Use when you need the raw list of all sources. For display-friendly labels, use providers_label. For the single primary provider, see provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.source_job_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Source
dimensions.description: Name of the discovery job that found this asset. Use when filtering by discovery job or checking which job populated the asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.super_category
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Category_old
dimensions.description: Top-level classification of the asset (e.g., "compute", "network", "iot", "storage"). Use when asking 'show assets by category' or high-level grouping. For display, use super_category_label. For finer categories, see categories. For taxonomy-based classification, see taxonomy_super_category.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.super_category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded SuperCategoryLabel
dimensions.description: Capitalized display name for super category (e.g., "Compute", "Network", "Iot"). Prefer this over super_category for display. For the raw value, see super_category.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.system_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded SystemTags
dimensions.description: System-assigned tags as a JSON object. Auto-generated tags set by the platform. For user-defined tags, see user_tags. For merged user and system tags, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.display_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded display_type
dimensions.description: Raw asset or resource type identifier in snake_case format (e.g., "aws_ec2_instances", "aws_s3_buckets"). Primarily for internal compatibility. Use when asking about asset types or grouping by resource type. For human-readable categories, prefer categories_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.user_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded UserTags
dimensions.description: User-defined tags as a JSON object with key-value pairs. Use when filtering or viewing custom tags applied by users. For system-generated tags, see system_tags. For merged tags, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.vendor
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Vendor
dimensions.description: Hardware or software vendor/manufacturer (e.g., "Cisco", "Dell", "Microsoft"). Use when asking 'show assets by vendor', 'which vendor', or filtering by manufacturer.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.violations
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Violations
dimensions.description: Array of violation flags for each insight on this asset. Primarily for Builder compatibility. All insights in this cube have violated=true since non-violated insights are filtered out.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.created_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded FirstSync
dimensions.description: When the asset was first created/discovered in the system. Use when filtering by creation date, e.g., 'assets created in the last 30 days'. For first network observation, see first_seen. For last update, see updated_at.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.updated_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded LastSync
dimensions.description: When the asset record was last updated in the system. Use when filtering by 'recently updated assets' or sorting by last update time. For last network observation, see last_seen. For creation time, see created_at.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.deleted_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded DeleteTime
dimensions.description: When the asset was soft-deleted. Null means the asset is active. Use segments 'existing_assets' or 'removed_assets' instead of filtering this directly. For creation time, see created_at. For last update, see updated_at.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.effective_change_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Effective Change At
dimensions.description: Latest lifecycle timestamp for the asset (greatest of created_at, updated_at, deleted_at). Used as the delta sync sort key.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.first_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded FirstSeen
dimensions.description: When the asset was first observed on the network. Use when asking 'when was this asset first seen' or filtering by first seen date. For first system sync time, see created_at.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.last_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded LastSeen
dimensions.description: When the asset was last observed on the network. Use when asking 'when was this asset last seen', 'stale assets not seen in 30 days', or filtering by last seen date. For last system update, see updated_at.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.user_count
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded User Count
dimensions.description: Number of distinct users who logged on to this asset in the last 7 days. Use when asking 'how many users logged into this device', 'devices with most users', or sorting by user activity.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.logon_user_names
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded UseridToUserNameMap

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.count
measures.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Count
measures.description: Total number of asset rows. In this aggregated cube each asset produces one row, so this equals the asset count. Use when asking 'how many assets' or 'total count'. For a deduplicated count by unique identifier, use assetsCount. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.assetsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Assets Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets (unique CQIDs). Each asset is counted once regardless of grouping. Use when asking 'how many assets', 'how many devices', or 'asset count'. Prefer this over count for deduplicated totals. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insightsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Insights Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets that have at least one security insight or violation. Use when asking 'how many assets have insights', 'assets with issues', or 'assets with violations'. Unlike assetsCount which counts all assets, this only includes those with active insight sub-classifications.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.percent
measures.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Percent
measures.description: Percentage of rows relative to the total result set. Use when asking 'what percentage of total' for row-level breakdowns. For percentage of unique assets, use assetsPercent. For percentage of assets with insights, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.assetsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Assets Percent
measures.description: Percentage of unique assets relative to total unique assets in the result. Use when asking 'what percentage of assets', 'asset distribution', or 'share of assets' grouped by a dimension. For row-level percentages, use percent. For insight-specific percentages, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Agg_Expanded.insightsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Agg Expanded Insights Percent
measures.description: Percentage of assets-with-insights relative to total assets-with-insights. Use when asking 'what percentage of insights' or 'insight distribution' grouped by a dimension. For general asset percentages, use assetsPercent instead.

full.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded
full.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded
full.description: Join cube combining normalised asset attributes and network interface attributes. This non-aggregated version keeps insight rows at detailed grain, so one asset can produce multiple rows when multiple indicators/rules exist. Use this cube when a query needs BOTH asset/insight context AND interface-level fields such as interface name, VLANs, VRF, trunk status, link aggregation, switch/wireless info, or DHCP lease details. Example queries: "show active insights on assets connected to trunk interfaces", "list assets with failed registration insights and interface oper status down", or "find devices with specific VRF names and their insight indicators". Do NOT use this cube for provider raw attributes; use Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded or Asset_Insight_ProviderData_Expanded when provider-specific columns are required.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Account ID
dimensions.description: Internal tenant identifier, automatically filtered by the platform's security context. Each query is scoped to a single account. Use when asking about tenant or account scope.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.cqid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded CQID
dimensions.description: Unique CloudQuery identifier for each asset/device. The canonical asset ID across all discovery sources. Use when filtering or looking up a specific asset by its ID (CQID).

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.composite_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Composite ID
dimensions.description: Internal composite key combining account and asset identifiers for row-level uniqueness. Structural primary key for the cube. Use when deduplicating or identifying unique rows.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.category
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Type_old
dimensions.description: Individual asset category (unnested from array). One asset may appear in multiple categories, producing multiple rows. Use when filtering or grouping by category. For display names, use category_label. For the full list per asset, use categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Type_old_label
dimensions.description: Human-readable display name for the asset category. Use for display instead of category. For filtering or grouping by category, use category.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Type_oldies
dimensions.description: All categories for an asset as a JSON array string. Primarily for internal compatibility. Use when you need the full list of categories per asset. For filtering or grouping, use category instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded CIDR
dimensions.description: Network CIDR blocks associated with the asset as a JSON array string. Use when asking about network ranges, subnets, or CIDR blocks of an asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.cloud_account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Cloud Account ID
dimensions.description: The cloud provider account identifier (e.g., AWS account ID, Azure subscription). Use when filtering by cloud account or grouping assets by their cloud account.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.context
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Context
dimensions.description: Discovery context metadata describing how the asset was found. Use when filtering or grouping by asset discovery context.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.dhcp_fingerprint
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded DHCP Fingerprint
dimensions.description: DHCP fingerprint string used for device identification on the network. Use when asking about DHCP fingerprint or network-level device identification.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.discovery_host
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded OPHID
dimensions.description: Display name of the on-premises discovery host that found this asset. Represents the appliance name, not the OPHID identifier. For the On-Prem Host ID, use ophid instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.indicator_rule_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Indicator Rule ID
dimensions.description: Unique ID of the insight indicator rule that triggered the finding. More specific than insight_indicator, identifying the exact rule version. Use when filtering by a specific insight rule.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insight_classification
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Classification
dimensions.description: Top-level classification of the security insight (e.g., "registration", "security"). Use when asking about insight type or grouping by classification. For display names, use insight_classification_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insight_classification_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Classification label
dimensions.description: Human-readable label for the insight classification. Use for display instead of insight_classification. For combined classification and confidence, use insight_classification_confidence_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insight_classification_confidence_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Insight Classification and Confidence label
dimensions.description: Combined label showing both the insight classification and confidence level (e.g., "Security High"). Use when grouping by the combination of insight type and confidence. For classification alone, use insight_classification_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insight_confidence
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Insight Confidence
dimensions.description: Confidence level of the insight finding (e.g., high, medium, low). Use when asking about insight confidence, filtering by confidence, or grouping insights by confidence level. For display names, use insight_confidence_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insight_confidence_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Insight Confidence label
dimensions.description: Human-readable label for the insight confidence level. Use for display instead of insight_confidence. For filtering or grouping by confidence, use insight_confidence.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insight_indicator
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Insight Indicator
dimensions.description: Specific indicator that triggered the insight, identifying a particular security check. Use when asking which indicator or check failed. For display names, use insight_indicator_label. For rule-level detail, use indicator_rule_id.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insight_indicator_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Insight Indicator label
dimensions.description: Human-readable name of the insight indicator. Use for display instead of insight_indicator. For registration-specific indicators, use insight_registration_indicator_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insight_registration_indicator
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Registration Indicator
dimensions.description: Indicator ID only for registration-type insights. Empty for non-registration insights. Use when querying registration-related indicators. For its display name, use insight_registration_indicator_label. For all insight indicators, use insight_indicator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insight_registration_indicator_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Registration Indicator label
dimensions.description: Human-readable name of the registration indicator. Use for display instead of insight_registration_indicator. For general insight indicator labels, use insight_indicator_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insight_registration_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Registration Status
dimensions.description: Whether the asset is registered or unregistered based on registration-type insights. Values: "registered", "unregistered", or empty. Use when asking about registration status. For display, use insight_registration_status_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insight_registration_status_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Registration Status Label
dimensions.description: Capitalized display label for registration status (e.g., "Registered", "Unregistered"). Use for display instead of insight_registration_status. For filtering, use insight_registration_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insight_state
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Insight State
dimensions.description: Current state of the insight (e.g., "active", "none"). Use when asking whether an insight is active, filtering by insight state, or checking current insight status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insight_sub_classification
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded SubClassification
dimensions.description: Detailed sub-classification of the insight within its parent classification. Use when drilling into specific insight types or grouping by sub-classification. For display names, use insight_sub_classification_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insight_sub_classification_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded SubClassification label
dimensions.description: Human-readable label for the insight sub-classification. Use for display instead of insight_sub_classification. For filtering or grouping, use insight_sub_classification.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.ip_address
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded IP Address
dimensions.description: Individual IP address of the asset (unnested from array). One asset may have multiple IPs, producing multiple rows. Use when filtering or searching by a specific IP address, e.g., "find asset with IP 10.0.0.1". For the full list per asset, use ip_addresses. For primary discovery IP, use device_ip_dotted.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.ips_for_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Ips for Filter
dimensions.description: Internal dimension for filter pushdown optimization. Structural field used by the query builder infrastructure. For IP-based filtering or display, use ip_address or device_ip_dotted instead.

dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded IP Addresses
dimensions.description: All IP addresses of the asset as a JSON array string. Primarily for internal compatibility. For filtering or grouping by individual IP, use ip_address instead. For primary discovery IP, use device_ip_dotted.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.location
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Location
dimensions.description: Raw location string of the asset. For human-readable location names, use location_label instead. For region-specific location with provider context, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.location_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Location label
dimensions.description: Human-readable location derived from provider and region (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Falls back to region name or "Global". Use when asking where an asset is located. For provider-qualified region, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.mac_address
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded MAC Address
dimensions.description: Individual MAC address of the asset (unnested from array). One asset may have multiple MACs, producing multiple rows. Use when filtering or searching by a specific MAC address. For the full list per asset, use mac_addresses.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded MAC Addresses
dimensions.description: All MAC addresses of the asset as a JSON array string. Primarily for internal compatibility. For filtering or grouping by individual MAC, use mac_address instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.managed
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Managed/Unmanaged
dimensions.description: Whether the asset is managed (true) or unmanaged (false). Use when asking about managed devices, unmanaged assets, or filtering by management status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.model
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Model
dimensions.description: Hardware model of the asset/device (e.g., "Cisco ISR 4331"). Use when asking about device model, hardware model, or grouping by model.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Name
dimensions.description: Display name or hostname of the asset. Use when searching by name or displaying asset details. For network discovery device name specifically, use device_name.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.ophid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded OPHID
dimensions.description: On-Prem Host ID, the unique identifier of the on-premises host appliance associated with this asset. Use when filtering by OPHID or looking up assets tied to a specific on-prem host. For the discovery host display name, use discovery_host.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.os
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Operating System

dimensions.description: Individual perspective tag (unnested from array). One asset may have multiple tags, producing multiple rows. Use when filtering or grouping by a specific perspective tag. For the full list per asset, use perspective_tags.

dimensions.description: Primary discovery source or cloud provider (e.g., "aws", "azure", "gcp", "nios", "servicenow"). Use when filtering or grouping by provider. For display names, use provider_label. For all sources including secondary, use providers_label_iterator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.provider_label

dimensions.description: Human-readable provider name with proper casing (e.g., "AWS", "GCP", "Azure", "ServiceNow"). Use for display instead of provider. For all sources with labels, use providers_label_iterator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.providers_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: All providers/sources for this asset as a formatted array with display labels. Use when displaying the full list of sources per asset. For individual source grouping, use providers_label_iterator. For a single primary source, use provider_label.

dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: Each source/provider unnested into individual rows with display labels. An asset discovered by 3 providers produces 3 rows. Use when grouping or filtering by all sources. For raw values, use providers_iterator. For primary source only, use provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.providers_iterator
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Providers_iterator
dimensions.description: Each raw source/provider unnested into individual rows. Use for filtering by any discovery source. For display-friendly names, use providers_label_iterator instead. For primary source only, use provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.provider_location_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Provider Location Label
dimensions.description: Alias for provider_region_label. Human-readable label combining provider and region. For the canonical region label, use provider_region_label instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.provider_region_label_old
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Provider Region Label
dimensions.description: Legacy format of provider+region label. Used internally by provider_region_label. For region display, use provider_region_label instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.provider_region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Region Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable region label (e.g., "AWS US East (N. Virginia)", "Unassigned"). Use when asking about asset region, showing assets by region, or displaying region info. For raw region code, use provider_region. For location without provider prefix, use location_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.provider_region
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Provider Region
dimensions.description: Raw cloud region code (e.g., "us-east-1", "westus2"). Use for filtering by exact region code. For display-friendly region names, use provider_region_label instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.provider_label_filter_based
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Provider label from filter
dimensions.description: Provider label derived from the reconciliation filter. Used internally by the reconciliation dimension. For general provider display, use provider_label instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.reconciliation
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Reconciliation
dimensions.description: Cross-source reconciliation status for a given provider filter. Values: "Matching" (found in selected provider AND others), "Missing From X" (not in selected provider), "Only in X" (only in selected provider). Use when asking which assets are missing from a provider. Requires reconciliation_filter to be set.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.reconciliation_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Reconciliation filter

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.region

dimensions.description: Raw cloud region code. For display-friendly region names, use provider_region_label. For raw region with provider context, use provider_region.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Region Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable cloud region label (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Hidden structural field. For region display, use provider_region_label instead, which includes provider context.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.resource

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.secondary_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Secondary Providers

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.severity
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Severity
dimensions.description: Severity level of the insight (e.g., "critical", "high", "medium", "low"). Use when asking about insight severity, filtering by severity, or grouping insights by severity level.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.source_table

dimensions.description: Internal source table name for data lineage debugging. Structural field indicating the origin of the asset record.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.providers

dimensions.description: All discovery sources/providers for this asset as a JSON array string. Primarily for internal compatibility. For filtering or grouping by individual source, use providers_iterator or providers_label_iterator instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.source_job_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Source Job Name
dimensions.description: Name of the discovery job that found this asset. Use when filtering by discovery job or identifying which job populated the asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.super_category
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Category_old
dimensions.description: Top-level asset classification (e.g., "compute", "network", "iot", "storage"). Use when grouping by high-level asset type. For display, use super_category_label. For taxonomy-based classification, use taxonomy_super_category.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.super_category_label

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.system_tags

dimensions.description: System-generated tags as a JSON object string. Auto-assigned metadata tags. Use when querying system-level tags. For user-defined tags, use user_tags. For all tags combined, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.display_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Asset/Resource type
dimensions.description: Raw asset or resource type identifier (e.g., "aws_ec2_instances", "aws_s3_buckets"). Internal type identifiers. Primarily for internal compatibility. For taxonomy-based asset types, use taxonomy_type or taxonomy_type_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.user_tags
