dimensions.description: User-defined tags as a JSON object string with key-value pairs. Use when filtering or viewing custom tags applied by users. For system tags, use system_tags. For all tags combined, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.vendor
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Vendor
dimensions.description: Hardware or software vendor/manufacturer (e.g., "Cisco", "Dell", "Microsoft"). Use when asking about asset vendor, manufacturer, or grouping by vendor.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.violated
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Violated
dimensions.description: Whether the insight rule was violated (true/false). All rows in this cube have violated=true since non-violated insights are filtered out. Structural field indicating active violations.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.created_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Created Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was first created/discovered in the system. Use when filtering by creation date, such as assets created in the last 30 days. For when the asset was first observed on the network, use first_seen.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.updated_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Updated Time
dimensions.description: When the asset record was last updated. Use when filtering by recently updated assets or sorting by last update time. For device discovery update time specifically, use updated_time.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.deleted_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Delete Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was soft-deleted. Null means the asset is active. Use segments existing_assets or removed_assets instead of filtering this directly.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.first_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded First Seen Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was first observed on the network. Use when asking when an asset was first seen. For asset creation time in the system, use created_at. For device first discovery time, use device_first_occurrence_time.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.last_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Last Seen Time
dimensions.description: When the asset was last observed on the network. Use when asking about stale assets or filtering by last seen date. For discovery service last check time, use discovery_status_last_seen.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.length_categories_old
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Length of categories array
dimensions.description: Count of categories assigned to the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator. Can be used to find assets with a specific number of categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.length_ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Length of ips array
dimensions.description: Count of IP addresses on the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator. Can be used to find assets with multiple IPs or exactly one IP.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.length_di_ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Length of di_ip_addresses array
dimensions.description: Count of IP addresses assigned to this interface. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.length_cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Length of cidrs array
dimensions.description: Count of CIDR blocks associated with the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.length_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Length of Provider array
dimensions.description: Count of discovery sources for the asset. Used internally for array matching. Use when asking how many providers discovered this asset or finding assets found by multiple sources.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.length_secondary_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Length of secondary_providers array
dimensions.description: Count of secondary providers for the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.length_mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Length of mac_addresses array
dimensions.description: Count of MAC addresses on the asset. Used internally for array matching with the IS EXACTLY operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Combines both user_tags and system_tags in same order
dimensions.description: Merged JSON object of both user_tags and system_tags. Use when querying across all tags regardless of type. For individual tag systems, use user_tags or system_tags. For available tag keys, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.combined_tags_all_keys
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Distinct Keys from user tags and system_tags
dimensions.description: Distinct list of all tag key names across user and system tags as a JSON array. Use when asking what tags are available or listing all tag keys. Query with ungrouped=true. For values of a specific key, use combined_tags_values_for_a_key.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.combined_tags_values_for_a_key
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Distinct Keys from user tags and system_tags
dimensions.description: Distinct values for a specific tag key, returned as a JSON array. Requires combined_tags filter set to the desired key name. Query with ungrouped=true. For available tag keys, use combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.user_count
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Users
dimensions.description: Number of distinct users who logged on to this asset in the last 7 days. Use when asking how many users logged into a device, finding devices with most users, or sorting by user activity.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.device_ip_dotted
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded IPAddress
dimensions.description: Primary IP address of the device in dotted notation (e.g., "192.168.1.1"). One IP per device for display in tables. For all asset IPs or IP-based filtering, use ip_address. For the full IP list, use ip_addresses.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.device_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded DeviceName
dimensions.description: Device hostname from network discovery context. Use when displaying or filtering by the network discovery device name. For the general asset display name, use name instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.device_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded DeviceType
dimensions.description: Type classification of the network device (e.g., "Router", "Switch", "Firewall"). Use when asking about device type or grouping by device type. For confidence in the type identification, use type_probability.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.reachable_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded ReachedStatus
dimensions.description: Network reachability status of the device (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking if a device is reachable or filtering by connectivity status. For details, use reachable_message. For overall device health, use overall_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.reachable_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded ReachedMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message explaining the reachability status. Use when drilling down into why a device is unreachable. For the status summary, use reachable_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.snmp_credential_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded SNMPCredentialStatus
dimensions.description: Status of the SNMP credential check (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking about SNMP credential issues or filtering by SNMP authentication status. For details, use snmp_credential_message. For collection status, use snmp_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.snmp_credential_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded SNMPCredentialMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message explaining the SNMP credential status. Use when debugging SNMP credential failures. For the status summary, use snmp_credential_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.snmp_collection_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded SNMPCollectionStatus
dimensions.description: Status of SNMP data collection (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking about SNMP collection issues. For details, use snmp_collection_message. For credential status, use snmp_credential_status. For whether collection is enabled, use snmp_collection_enabled.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.snmp_collection_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded SNMPCollectionMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about SNMP collection status. Use when debugging SNMP collection failures. For the status summary, use snmp_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.cli_credential_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded CLICredentialStatus
dimensions.description: Status of CLI (SSH/Telnet) credential validation. Use when checking CLI authentication status across devices. For details, use cli_credential_message. For whether CLI collection is enabled, use cli_collection_enabled. For overall device health, use overall_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.cli_credential_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded CLICredentialMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about CLI credential status. Use when debugging CLI access failures. For the status summary, use cli_credential_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.finger_print_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded FingerPrintStatus
dimensions.description: Status of device fingerprinting (device type identification). Use when checking if device type was successfully identified. For details, use finger_print_message. For the confidence level, use type_probability. For overall device health, use overall_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.finger_print_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded FingerPrintMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about device fingerprinting status. Use when debugging fingerprinting failures. For the status summary, use finger_print_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.sdn_collection_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded SDNCollectionStatus
dimensions.description: Status of SDN (Software Defined Networking) data collection. Use when checking SDN integration status. For details, use sdn_collection_message. For whether SDN collection is enabled, use sdn_collection_enabled. For overall device health, use overall_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.sdn_collection_message
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded SDNCollectionMessage
dimensions.description: Detailed message about SDN collection status. Use when debugging SDN collection failures. For the status summary, use sdn_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.updated_time
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded LastUpdate
dimensions.description: When the device discovery status was last updated. Use when asking about last device update or sorting devices by most recent update. For the asset record update time, use updated_at instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.device_first_occurrence_time
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded FirstSeen
dimensions.description: When this device was first discovered via network scanning. Use when asking when a device was first found. For the asset-level first seen time, use first_seen instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.last_action
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded LastAction
dimensions.description: Most recent action performed on or by the device (e.g., discovery scan, configuration change). Use when checking the last activity on a device.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.discovery_status_last_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded DiscoveryLastSeen
dimensions.description: When the discovery service last observed this device. Use when finding stale or offline devices. For the asset-level last seen time, use last_seen instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.app_infra_service_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded DiscoveryService
dimensions.description: Identifier of the discovery service/appliance that manages this device. Use when filtering by discovery service or finding devices managed by a specific service.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.overall_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded OverallStatus
dimensions.description: Overall health/discovery status of the device, summarizing protocol-specific checks. Use when asking about device status or filtering by overall health. For individual protocol status, use reachable_status, snmp_collection_status, cli_credential_status, or sdn_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.snmp_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded SNMPCollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether SNMP collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking if SNMP is enabled or filtering by SNMP on/off. For SNMP collection results, use snmp_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.cli_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded CLICollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether CLI (SSH/Telnet) collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking if CLI collection is enabled or filtering by CLI on/off. For CLI credential results, use cli_credential_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.sdn_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded SDNCollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether SDN collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking if SDN is enabled. For SDN collection results, use sdn_collection_status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.device_assurance
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Device Assurance
dimensions.description: Numeric confidence score (0-100) for device type identification. Hidden internal field used to derive type_probability. For the categorized confidence level, use type_probability instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.type_probability
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded TypeProbability
dimensions.description: Confidence category for device type identification: LOW (0-20), MEDIUM (21-74), HIGH (75-100). Use when asking about device type confidence or filtering by identification reliability. Derived from device_assurance score.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.taxonomy_origins
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded taxonomy_origins
dimensions.description: All taxonomy origin classifications as a JSON array (e.g., ["cloud", "on-prem"]). Use when you need the full list of origins per asset. For filtering or grouping by individual origin, use taxonomy_origin instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.taxonomy_origin
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded taxonomy_origin
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy origin (unnested). Values like "cloud", "on-prem". Use when grouping or filtering by origin, e.g., "show cloud vs on-prem assets". For the full list per asset, use taxonomy_origins.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.taxonomy_resource_types
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded taxonomy_resource_types
dimensions.description: All taxonomy resource type classifications as a JSON array. Use when you need the full list of resource types per asset. For filtering or grouping, use taxonomy_resource_type instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.taxonomy_resource_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded taxonomy_resource_type
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy resource type classification (unnested). Use when grouping or filtering by resource type classification. For the full list per asset, use taxonomy_resource_types.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.taxonomy_super_categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Category
dimensions.description: All taxonomy super category classifications as a JSON array (e.g., ["compute", "iot"]). Use when you need the full list per asset. For filtering or grouping, use taxonomy_super_category. For display labels, use taxonomy_super_categories_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.length_categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded LengthOfTaxonomySuperCategoriesArray
dimensions.description: Count of taxonomy super categories assigned to the asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching with the 'IS EXACTLY' operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.taxonomy_super_category
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded taxonomy_super_category
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy-based super category (unnested). Use when grouping by taxonomy super category. For the legacy classification, use super_category. For display, use taxonomy_super_category_label. For the full list per asset, use taxonomy_super_categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.taxonomy_super_categories_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded taxonomy_super_categories_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted taxonomy super categories as a JSON array (e.g., ["Compute", "IoT"]). For individual labels, use taxonomy_super_category_label. For raw values, use taxonomy_super_categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.taxonomy_super_category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded taxonomy_super_category_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted individual taxonomy super category (e.g., "IoT", "Compute"). Use for display. For filtering or grouping, use taxonomy_super_category. For legacy super category display, use super_category_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.taxonomy_types
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Type
dimensions.description: All taxonomy type classifications as a JSON array. Most granular level of taxonomy. For filtering or grouping, use taxonomy_type instead. For display labels, use taxonomy_types_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.length_taxonomy_types
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded LengthOfTaxonomyTypesArray
dimensions.description: Count of taxonomy types assigned to the asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching with the 'IS EXACTLY' operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.taxonomy_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded taxonomy_type
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy type (unnested). Most specific taxonomy classification. Use when grouping or filtering by the most detailed asset type. For display, use taxonomy_type_label. For the full list per asset, use taxonomy_types.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.taxonomy_types_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded taxonomy_types_labels
dimensions.description: Display-formatted taxonomy types as a JSON array. "Uncategorized" for unknown types. For individual type labels, use taxonomy_type_label. For raw values, use taxonomy_types.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.taxonomy_type_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded taxonomy_type_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted individual taxonomy type. Falls back to raw value or "Uncategorized". Use for display. For filtering or grouping, use taxonomy_type instead. For internal type identifiers, use display_type.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.taxonomy_path
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded taxonomy_path
dimensions.description: Full taxonomy hierarchy path as a JSON array of "origin/resource_type/super_category/type" strings (e.g., ["cloud/infrastructure/compute/virtual_machine"]). Use when displaying the complete taxonomy hierarchy or for hierarchical grouping.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.os_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded OSType
dimensions.description: OS family/type (e.g., "IOS-XE", "Windows", "Linux"). Use when grouping by OS family or filtering by OS type. For the full OS name, use os. For the specific version, use os_version.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.os_version
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded OSVersion
dimensions.description: Specific version of the operating system (e.g., "17.3.4", "22.04"). Use when filtering by exact OS version or checking for outdated versions. For the full OS name, use os. For the OS family, use os_type.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.serial_number
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded SerialNumber
dimensions.description: Hardware serial number of the device. Use when looking up a specific device by serial number.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.os_build
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded OSBuild
dimensions.description: Build number or identifier of the operating system (e.g., "22H2", "19045.3086"). Use when filtering by specific OS build or identifying patch levels.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.parent_container_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded ParentContainerId
dimensions.description: Identifier of the parent container this asset belongs to, when the asset was discovered as part of a container or virtualization hierarchy. Empty for standalone assets. Use when associating assets with their parent container.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.device_support
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded DeviceSupport
dimensions.description: Device support status reported by discovery, indicating whether the device is supported for detailed discovery collection. Use when filtering assets by discovery support status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.os_eos
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded OSEos
dimensions.description: Date when the OS version reaches End of Support (vendor stops providing updates). Use when asking about end of support dates or identifying assets with unsupported OS versions.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.os_eol
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded OSEol
dimensions.description: Date when the OS version reaches End of Life (no longer maintained). Use when asking about end of life devices or identifying fully retired OS versions.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.os_eossec
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded OSEosSec
dimensions.description: Date when security patches stop for this OS version. Use when asking about end of security support or assessing security risk from outdated OS.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.os_release_date
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded OSReleaseDate
dimensions.description: When this OS version was originally released. Use when asking about OS version age or checking release timeline.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.os_latest_version_date
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded OSLatestVersionDate
dimensions.description: Date of the latest available version for this OS family. Use when comparing current version age against the latest available update.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_cqid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Cqid
dimensions.description: Unique CloudQuery identifier of the parent device. Use when filtering interfaces by a specific device or joining with asset details.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Account ID
dimensions.description: Tenant or customer account identifier. Automatically filtered by security context. Rarely needed in queries directly.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_interface_classification
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Interface Classification
dimensions.description: Classification of the interface (e.g., "physical", "virtual", "loopback"). Use when asking "what type of interface" or grouping by interface classification.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_description
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Description
dimensions.description: User-configured description of the interface. Use when searching by interface description or displaying interface details.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_updated_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Updated at
dimensions.description: When this interface record was last synced/ingested. Use when filtering by data freshness.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_created_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Created at
dimensions.description: Timestamp of when this device interface record was first created. Null when the value is epoch zero.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Name
dimensions.description: Name of the network interface (e.g., "GigabitEthernet0/0", "eth0", "Vlan100"). Use when filtering or searching by interface name.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_mac_address
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Mac Address
dimensions.description: MAC address of the interface. Use when searching by MAC address or displaying interface hardware address.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Ip Addresses
dimensions.description: All IP addresses assigned to this interface as a JSON array. Use when viewing per-interface IP assignments.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Type
dimensions.description: Type of the network interface (e.g., "ethernetCsmacd", "tunnel", "propVirtual"). Use when grouping or filtering by interface type.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_admin_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Admin Status
dimensions.description: Raw administrative status of the interface (e.g., "interface_state_up_up", "interface_state_down"). Use "di_admin_status_label" for display-friendly values.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_admin_status_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Admin Status Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable administrative status ("Up", "Down", or "-"). Use when asking "is the interface admin up or down" or filtering by admin status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_oper_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Oper Status
dimensions.description: Raw operational status of the interface. Use "di_oper_status_label" for display-friendly values.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_oper_status_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Oper Status Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable operational status ("Up", "Down", or "-"). Use when asking "is the interface operationally up" or filtering by oper status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_speed_mbps
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Speed Mbps
dimensions.description: Interface speed in megabits per second. Use when asking "how fast is this interface", sorting by speed, or filtering by bandwidth.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_vlans
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Vlans
dimensions.description: VLAN assignments on this interface as a JSON array of tuples (vlan_id, vlan_name). Use "di_vlans_ids" or "di_vlans_names" for extracted values.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_vlans_ids
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Vlans IDs
dimensions.description: VLAN IDs assigned to this interface as a JSON array. Use when filtering or listing VLANs on an interface.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_vlans_names
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Vlans Names
dimensions.description: VLAN names assigned to this interface as a JSON array. Use when displaying VLAN names.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_is_trunk
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Is Trunk
dimensions.description: Whether this interface is configured as a trunk port. Use "di_trunk_status" for display-friendly label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_trunk_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Trunk Status
dimensions.description: Whether the port is "Trunk" or "Access" mode. Use when asking "is this a trunk port", grouping by trunk vs access, or filtering by port mode.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_is_aggregation_member
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Is Aggregation Member
dimensions.description: Whether this interface is a member of a link aggregation group (e.g., LACP). Use "di_link_aggregation" for display-friendly label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_aggregated_interface_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Aggregated Interface Name
dimensions.description: Name of the parent aggregation interface this member belongs to (e.g., "Port-channel1"). Empty if not a member.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_is_aggregated
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Is Aggregated
dimensions.description: Whether this interface is an aggregation interface (e.g., a port-channel). Use "di_link_aggregation" for display-friendly label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_link_aggregation
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Link Aggregation
dimensions.description: Link aggregation role: "Member" (part of a group), "Aggregation" (the group interface), or "N/A". Use when asking about LAG/LACP status or grouping by aggregation role.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_link_aggregation_members
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Link Aggregation Members
dimensions.description: Member interfaces of this aggregation group as a JSON array. Only populated for aggregation interfaces.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_vrf_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Vrf Name
dimensions.description: VRF (Virtual Routing and Forwarding) name assigned to this interface. Use when filtering by VRF or checking VRF membership.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_vrf_rd
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Vrf Rd
dimensions.description: Route Distinguisher of the VRF. Use when querying VRF routing details.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_vrf_description
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Vrf Description
dimensions.description: Description of the VRF. Use when displaying VRF details.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_attached_devices
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Attached Devices
dimensions.description: Devices connected to this interface as a JSON array of tuples (device_name, device_type, mac_address, ip_address). Use the di_attached_devices_* dimensions for individual fields.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_attached_devices_names
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Attached Devices Names
dimensions.description: Names of devices connected to this interface as a JSON array. Use when listing attached device names.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_attached_devices_types
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Attached Devices Types
dimensions.description: Types of devices connected to this interface as a JSON array. Use when checking what types of devices are attached.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_attached_devices_mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Attached Devices Mac Addresses
dimensions.description: MAC addresses of devices connected to this interface as a JSON array.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.di_attached_devices_ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Di Attached Devices Ip Addresses

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.count
measures.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Count
measures.description: Total number of rows including asset-insight combinations. One asset may produce multiple rows if it has multiple insights. Use when asking about total records or row counts. For unique asset count, use assetsCount. For assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.assetsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Assets Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets (unique CQIDs). Each asset is counted once regardless of insights. Use when asking how many assets, devices, or total unique assets. For total rows, use count. For assets with insights only, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insightsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Insights Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets that have at least one active security insight or violation. Use when asking how many assets have insights or violations. For all unique assets, use assetsCount. For total rows, use count.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.percent
measures.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Percent
measures.description: Percentage of rows relative to the total result set. Use when asking about row-level percentage breakdowns. For percentage of unique assets, use assetsPercent. For percentage of assets with insights, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.assetsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Assets Percent
measures.description: Percentage of unique assets relative to total unique assets. Use when asking about asset distribution or share of assets grouped by a dimension. For row-level percentage, use percent. For insight percentage, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_Expanded.insightsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Expanded Insights Percent
measures.description: Percentage of assets-with-insights relative to total assets-with-insights. Use when asking about insight distribution grouped by a dimension. For asset distribution, use assetsPercent. For row percentage, use percent.

full.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded
full.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data Agg Expanded
full.description: Join cube combining normalised asset attributes with network interface data and raw provider discovery data. Each row represents one asset and exposes: (1) common asset fields -- name, OS, vendor, model, IP/MAC addresses, categories, location, managed status, first/last seen, tags, and source table; (2) aggregated security insights -- insight types, indicator IDs, confidence levels, severities, states, sub-classifications, and pre-computed composite keys like insight_types_confidence_levels; (3) network interface attributes -- interface details like VRF names, IP addresses, MAC addresses, etc.; and (4) raw provider attributes -- per-provider name, categories, OS, vendor, model, serial number, IPs, MACs, location, last seen, tags, pd_standardized_json_attributes, and the full pd_raw_json blob. Use this cube when a query needs BOTH common asset attributes AND BOTH network interface AND provider-specific attributes -- for example "show me AWS EC2 instances with their network interfaces and VPC configurations", "list devices with interface and provider data", or "filter assets by both interface properties and provider attributes". Do NOT use this cube for queries where either interface or provider data is not needed; prefer simpler cube like AssetDetails_ch_agg for those cases.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data Agg Expanded AccountId
dimensions.description: Internal tenant account identifier, automatically filtered by the platform's security context. Use when tenant-level filtering is needed. See cqid for the asset identifier.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.cqid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data Agg Expanded CQID
dimensions.description: Unique asset identifier assigned during discovery. Use when filtering or looking up a specific asset by its ID (CQID). See composite_id for the compound row-uniqueness key.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.composite_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data Agg Expanded CompositeID
dimensions.description: Composite key combining account_id and cqid, used as the internal primary key for row-level uniqueness. Use when a unique row identifier is needed. See cqid for the standalone asset identifier.

dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data Agg Expanded Type_old
dimensions.description: All asset categories as a JSON array. One asset may belong to multiple categories. Use when asking about 'asset types' or 'categories'. For human-readable names, use categories_label. For high-level grouping, use super_category instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.categories_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data Agg Expanded Type Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable display names for asset categories as a JSON array. Prefer this over categories for display. Use when the user refers to categories by friendly name. For raw category values, see categories.

dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data Agg Expanded CIDR
dimensions.description: Network CIDR blocks associated with the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about 'network ranges', 'subnets', or 'CIDR blocks' of an asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.cloud_account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data Agg Expanded CloudAccountID
dimensions.description: Cloud provider account ID (e.g., AWS account ID, Azure subscription). Use when filtering by 'cloud account', 'AWS account', or grouping assets by their cloud account.

dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data Agg Expanded Location Type
dimensions.description: Discovery context indicating the asset's deployment environment (e.g., on-prem, cloud). Use when asking about 'location type' or filtering cloud vs on-premises assets. For geographic region details, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.dhcp_fingerprint
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data Agg Expanded DHCPFingerprint
dimensions.description: DHCP fingerprint string used for network-level device identification. Use when asking about 'DHCP fingerprint' or 'device fingerprinting'.

dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data Agg Expanded OPHID
dimensions.description: Display name of the on-premises discovery host that found this asset. For the unique on-prem host identifier, use ophid instead. Primarily for internal reference.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data Agg Expanded Classifications
dimensions.description: Distinct insight classifications for this asset as a JSON array (e.g., ["registration", "security"]). Use when asking 'what types of insights' or grouping by insight classification. For display names, use insight_classifications_label. For finer detail, see insight_sub_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_classifications_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data Agg Expanded Classifications Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight classifications as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_classifications for display. Use when the user asks about insight types by friendly name. For raw values, see insight_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_confidences_label

Use when asking 'which indicators' or filtering by indicator. For display names, use insight_indicators_label. For rule definitions, see indicator_rule_ids.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Agg_Expanded.insight_indicators_label

full.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_Expanded
full.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data Expanded
full.description: Join cube combining normalised asset attributes, network interface attributes, and provider-specific raw attributes. This non-aggregated version keeps detailed insight rows, so one asset can produce multiple rows across indicators/rules and joined provider/interface records. Use this cube when a query needs the broadest field coverage across asset + insight + interface + provider domains in one result set. Example queries: "show unacknowledged high-severity insights for assets where interface is trunk and provider model matches X", "find assets with insight state active, provider tags containing Y, and interface VLAN Z", or "compare provider OS/version with interface telemetry for impacted assets". Do NOT use this cube for simple asset-only or insight-only analysis; prefer AssetDetails_ch_agg for better simplicity and performance.

full.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded
full.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data User Data Agg Expanded
full.description: Join cube combining normalised asset attributes with network interface data, raw provider discovery data, and per-user identity data. Each row represents one asset and exposes: (1) common asset fields -- name, OS, vendor, model, IP/MAC addresses, categories, location, managed status, first/last seen, tags, and source table; (2) aggregated security insights -- insight types, indicator IDs, confidence levels, severities, states, sub-classifications, and pre-computed composite keys like insight_types_confidence_levels; (3) network interface attributes -- interface details like VRF names, IP addresses, MAC addresses, etc.; (4) raw provider attributes -- per-provider name, categories, OS, vendor, model, serial number, IPs, MACs, location, last seen, tags, pd_standardized_json_attributes, and the full pd_raw_json blob; and (5) user identity fields -- first/last name, login ID, email, provider, and per-action provider map for the most recent user who logged on in the last 7 days. Use this cube when a query needs asset + interface + provider + user domains together -- for example "show assets with VPC interface and provider data where a specific user recently logged on". Do NOT use this cube for queries where user, interface, or provider data is not needed; prefer simpler cubes for those cases.

measures.description: Total number of asset rows. In this aggregated cube each asset produces one row, so this equals the asset count. Use when asking 'how many assets' or 'total count'. measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.assetsCount

measures.description: Number of distinct assets that have at least one security insight or violation. Use when asking 'how many assets have insights', 'assets with issues', or 'assets with violations'. measures.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Agg_Expanded.assetsPercent

full.name: Asset_Insight_DeviceInterface_ProviderData_UserData_Expanded
full.title: Asset Insight Device Interface Provider Data User Data Expanded
full.description: Join cube combining normalised asset attributes, network interface attributes, provider-specific raw attributes, and per-user identity data. Grain is one row per asset-insight combination. Use this cube when a query needs the broadest field coverage across asset + insight + interface + provider + user domains in one result set. Example queries: "show high-severity insights for assets where interface is trunk and logged-on user matches X", "find assets with active insight, provider tags containing Y, and interface VLAN Z with recent user logon". Do NOT use this cube for simple asset-only or insight-only analysis; prefer AssetDetails_ch_agg for better simplicity and performance.
