full.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded
full.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded
full.description: Primary aggregated asset cube combining normalised asset attributes, rolled-up insight arrays, and 7-day user logon summaries. Grain is one row per asset (CQID). Each row exposes: (1) common asset fields - name, OS, vendor, model, IP/MAC addresses, categories, location, managed status, first/last seen, tags, and source table; (2) aggregated security insight context - insight types, indicators, confidence levels, severities, states, sub-classifications, and pre-computed composite keys such as insight_types_confidence_levels; and (3) user activity rollups - distinct user count plus user-to-name/action/timestamp maps. This is the default workhorse cube for all general asset queries — use it with or without insight filtering. Use for any asset enumeration or attribute-based lookup, for example "list all Windows servers", "show all managed Linux devices by region", "list managed assets by OS and vendor", "find assets by name or IP", as well as insight-filtered analytics such as "show assets with active security insights by OS", "count assets by confidence and classification", or "list devices with recent user activity and violations". For interface- or provider-specific raw fields, use the corresponding *_agg_expanded cubes.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded AccountId
dimensions.description: Internal tenant account identifier, automatically filtered by the platform's security context. Use when tenant-level filtering is needed. See cqid for the asset identifier.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.cqid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded CQID
dimensions.description: Unique asset identifier assigned during discovery. Use when filtering or looking up a specific asset by its ID (CQID). See composite_id for the compound row-uniqueness key.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.composite_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded CompositeID
dimensions.description: Composite key combining account_id and cqid, used as the internal primary key for row-level uniqueness. Use when a unique row identifier is needed. See cqid for the standalone asset identifier.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Type_old
dimensions.description: All asset categories as a JSON array. One asset may belong to multiple categories. Use when asking about 'asset types' or 'categories'. For human-readable names, use categories_label. For high-level grouping, use super_category instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.categories_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Type Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable display names for asset categories as a JSON array. Prefer this over categories for display. Use when the user refers to categories by friendly name. For raw category values, see categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded CIDR
dimensions.description: Network CIDR blocks associated with the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about 'network ranges', 'subnets', or 'CIDR blocks' of an asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.cloud_account_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded CloudAccountID
dimensions.description: Cloud provider account ID (e.g., AWS account ID, Azure subscription). Use when filtering by 'cloud account', 'AWS account', or grouping assets by their cloud account.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.context
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Location Type
dimensions.description: Discovery context indicating the asset's deployment environment (e.g., on-prem, cloud). Use when asking about 'location type' or filtering cloud vs on-premises assets. For geographic region details, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.dhcp_fingerprint
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded DHCPFingerprint
dimensions.description: DHCP fingerprint string used for network-level device identification. Use when asking about 'DHCP fingerprint' or 'device fingerprinting'.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.discovery_host
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded OPHID
dimensions.description: Display name of the on-premises discovery host that found this asset. For the unique on-prem host identifier, use ophid instead. Primarily for internal reference.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.indicator_rule_ids
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded IndicatorRuleID
dimensions.description: Array of insight indicator rule IDs that triggered findings for this asset. Used for programmatic filtering of specific insight rules. For indicator identifiers, use insight_indicators; for display names, use insight_indicators_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Classifications
dimensions.description: Distinct insight classifications for this asset as a JSON array (e.g., ["registration", "security"]). Use when asking 'what types of insights' or grouping by insight classification. For display names, use insight_classifications_label. For finer detail, see insight_sub_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_classifications_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Classifications Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight classifications as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_classifications for display. Use when the user asks about insight types by friendly name. For raw values, see insight_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_confidences
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Confidence
dimensions.description: Array of confidence levels for all insights on this asset (e.g., ["high", "medium"]). Use when asking about insight confidence levels or filtering assets by confidence. For display labels, use insight_confidences_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_confidences_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded InsightConfidenceslabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight confidence levels as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_confidences for display. For raw confidence values used in filtering, see insight_confidences.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Indicator
dimensions.description: Array of insight indicator IDs for this asset. Each indicator represents a specific security check that was triggered. Use when asking 'which indicators' or filtering by indicator. For display names, use insight_indicators_label. For rule definitions, see indicator_rule_ids.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_indicators_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded InsightIndicatorslabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight indicators as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_indicators for display. For raw indicator IDs used in filtering, see insight_indicators.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded MissingRecords
dimensions.description: Array of distinct registration-type insight indicators identifying missing records or registration issues. Use when asking 'what registration indicators' or 'missing records'. For display labels, use insight_registration_indicators_label. For registration status, see insight_registration_statuses.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_indicators_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded RegistrationIndicatorslabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for registration indicators as a JSON array. Prefer this for display when showing missing records by friendly name. For raw indicator IDs, see insight_registration_indicators.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_statuses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded RegistrationStatus
dimensions.description: Array of distinct registration statuses for this asset (e.g., ["registered"], ["unregistered"]). Use when asking 'is the asset registered' or 'show unregistered assets'. For display labels, use insight_registration_statuses_label. For which rules triggered, see insight_registration_indicators.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_registration_statuses_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Registration Statuses Label
dimensions.description: Capitalized display labels for registration statuses (e.g., ["Registered"], ["Unregistered"]). Prefer this over insight_registration_statuses for display. For raw status values, see insight_registration_statuses.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_states
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded InsightStates
dimensions.description: Array of insight states (e.g., ["active", "none"]). Primarily for Builder compatibility. For filtering by insight type, prefer insight_classifications or insight_sub_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_sub_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded SubClassifications
dimensions.description: Array of insight sub-classifications providing finer detail within a classification. Use when drilling into specific insight types or filtering by sub-classification. For display labels, use insight_sub_classifications_label. For broader grouping, see insight_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insight_sub_classifications_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded SubClassifications Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable labels for insight sub-classifications as a JSON array. Prefer this over insight_sub_classifications for display. For raw sub-classification values, see insight_sub_classifications.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded IPAddresses
dimensions.description: All IP addresses of the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about an asset's IP addresses or displaying the full list of IPs.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.ips_for_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Ips for Filter
dimensions.description: Internal dimension for filter pushdown optimization on IP addresses. Used by the query builder infrastructure for efficient IP-based filtering.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.location
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded AssetLocation
dimensions.description: Raw location string of the asset. Primarily for Builder compatibility. For human-readable location, use provider_region_label instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded MACAddresses
dimensions.description: All MAC addresses of the asset as a JSON array. Use when asking about 'MAC addresses' or displaying hardware network identifiers per asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.managed
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Managed
dimensions.description: Whether the asset is managed (true) or unmanaged (false). Use when asking 'show managed assets', 'unmanaged devices', or filtering by management status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.model
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Model
dimensions.description: Hardware model of the asset/device (e.g., "Cisco ISR 4331"). Use when asking about 'device model', 'hardware model', or grouping by model.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Name
dimensions.description: Display name or hostname of the asset. Use when searching by name, e.g., 'find asset named X', or when displaying asset details.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.ophid
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded DiscoveryHost
dimensions.description: On-Prem Host ID, the unique identifier of the on-premises host or appliance associated with this asset. Use when filtering by OPHID or looking up assets tied to a specific on-prem host. For the display name, see discovery_host.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.os
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded OperatingSystem
dimensions.description: Operating system name of the asset (e.g., "Windows 10", "Ubuntu 22.04", "IOS-XE"). Use when asking 'what OS' or filtering by operating system. For the OS family, see os_type. For the version number, see os_version.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.perspective_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded PerspectiveTags
dimensions.description: All perspective tags for the asset as a JSON array. Use when querying perspective-level tag classifications. For user-defined or system tags, see combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.provider
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Provider
dimensions.description: Primary discovery source or cloud provider (e.g., "aws", "azure", "gcp", "nios", "servicenow"). Raw internal value. For display, use provider_label. For all sources including secondary, use providers.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.provider_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded ProviderLabel
dimensions.description: Human-readable provider name with proper casing (e.g., "AWS", "GCP", "Azure", "ServiceNow"). Prefer this over provider for display. For the raw value, see provider. For all sources, use providers_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.providers_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: All discovery providers for this asset as a formatted JSON array with proper casing. Use when displaying the full list of sources. For raw source values, see providers. For the single primary provider, see provider_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.providers_label_iterator
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded ProvidersLabel
dimensions.description: Each source/provider unnested into individual rows with display labels. An asset discovered by 3 providers produces 3 rows. Use when grouping or filtering by all sources. For raw values, use providers_iterator. For primary source only, use provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.provider_region_label_old
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded ProviderandLocationlabel_old
dimensions.description: Legacy format of provider+region label (e.g., "AWS: us-east-1"). Used internally by provider_region_label. Prefer provider_region_label for current region display.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.provider_region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Location_label
dimensions.description: Human-readable region label (e.g., "AWS US East (N. Virginia)", "Unassigned"). Use when asking 'which region', 'show assets by region', or displaying location. For raw region codes, see provider_region.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.provider_region
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Location
dimensions.description: Raw provider region code (e.g., "us-east-1", "westus2"). Use when filtering by exact region code. For display-friendly version, use provider_region_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.provider_label_filter_based
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Providerlabelfromfilter
dimensions.description: Provider label derived from the reconciliation filter value. Used internally by the reconciliation dimension for formatting. For provider display names, use provider_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.reconciliation
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Reconciliation
dimensions.description: Cross-source reconciliation status for a given provider filter. Values: 'Matching' (found in selected provider and others), 'Missing From X', 'Only in X'. Use when asking 'which assets are missing from AWS' or 'reconciliation report'. Requires reconciliation_filter to be set.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.reconciliation_filter
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Reconciliationfilter
dimensions.description: Filter dimension to select which provider to reconcile against (e.g., "aws"). Set this filter to enable reconciliation analysis via the reconciliation dimension.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.region
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Region
dimensions.description: Raw cloud region code. Primarily for Builder compatibility. Prefer provider_region for region filtering and provider_region_label for display.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.region_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Region Label
dimensions.description: Human-readable cloud region label (e.g., "US East (N. Virginia)"). Primarily for Builder compatibility. Prefer provider_region_label for region display.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.resource
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Resource
dimensions.description: Full raw asset record as a JSON string. Primarily for Builder compatibility. Use when the user wants to inspect the complete raw asset payload.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.secondary_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded SecondaryProviders
dimensions.description: Additional discovery sources beyond the primary provider as a JSON array. Primarily for Builder compatibility. For the complete list of all sources, use providers instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.severities
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Severity
dimensions.description: Array of insight severity levels for this asset. Primarily for Builder compatibility. Values include "critical", "high", "medium", "low".

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.source_table
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded SourceTable
dimensions.description: Internal source table name for data lineage debugging. Structural dimension for internal tracking.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Providers
dimensions.description: All discovery sources/providers for this asset as a JSON array. Use when you need the raw list of all sources. For display-friendly labels, use providers_label. For the single primary provider, see provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.source_job_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Source
dimensions.description: Name of the discovery job that found this asset. Use when filtering by discovery job or checking which job populated the asset.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.super_category
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Category_old
dimensions.description: Top-level classification of the asset (e.g., "compute", "network", "iot", "storage"). Use when asking 'show assets by category' or high-level grouping. For display, use super_category_label. For finer categories, see categories. For taxonomy-based classification, see taxonomy_super_category.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.super_category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded SuperCategoryLabel
dimensions.description: Capitalized display name for super category (e.g., "Compute", "Network", "Iot"). Prefer this over super_category for display. For the raw value, see super_category.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.system_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded SystemTags
dimensions.description: System-assigned tags as a JSON object. Auto-generated tags set by the platform. For user-defined tags, see user_tags. For merged user and system tags, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.display_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded display_type
dimensions.description: Raw asset or resource type identifier in snake_case format (e.g., "aws_ec2_instances", "aws_s3_buckets"). Primarily for internal compatibility. Use when asking about asset types or grouping by resource type. For human-readable categories, prefer categories_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.user_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded UserTags
dimensions.description: User-defined tags as a JSON object with key-value pairs. Use when filtering or viewing custom tags applied by users. For system-generated tags, see system_tags. For merged tags, use combined_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.vendor
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Vendor
dimensions.description: Hardware or software vendor/manufacturer (e.g., "Cisco", "Dell", "Microsoft"). Use when asking 'show assets by vendor', 'which vendor', or filtering by manufacturer.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.violations
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Violations
dimensions.description: Array of violation flags for each insight on this asset. Primarily for Builder compatibility. All insights in this cube have violated=true since non-violated insights are filtered out.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.created_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded FirstSync
dimensions.description: When the asset was first created/discovered in the system. Use when filtering by creation date, e.g., 'assets created in the last 30 days'. For first network observation, see first_seen. For last update, see updated_at.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.updated_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LastSync
dimensions.description: When the asset record was last updated in the system. Use when filtering by 'recently updated assets' or sorting by last update time. For last network observation, see last_seen. For creation time, see created_at.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.deleted_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded DeleteTime
dimensions.description: When the asset was soft-deleted. Null means the asset is active. Use segments 'existing_assets' or 'removed_assets' instead of filtering this directly. For creation time, see created_at. For last update, see updated_at.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.effective_change_at
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Effective Change At
dimensions.description: Latest lifecycle timestamp for the asset (greatest of created_at, updated_at, deleted_at). Used as the delta sync sort key.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.first_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded FirstSeen
dimensions.description: When the asset was first observed on the network. Use when asking 'when was this asset first seen' or filtering by first seen date. For first system sync time, see created_at.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.last_seen
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LastSeen
dimensions.description: When the asset was last observed on the network. Use when asking 'when was this asset last seen', 'stale assets not seen in 30 days', or filtering by last seen date. For last system update, see updated_at.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.user_count
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded User Count
dimensions.description: Number of distinct users who logged on to this asset in the last 7 days. Use when asking 'how many users logged into this device', 'devices with most users', or sorting by user activity.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.ud_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Ud Name
dimensions.description: First name of the user who last logged on to this asset in the past 7 days. Derived from the first token of user_name in composite_user. Null when no recent logon exists.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.ud_last_name
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Ud Last Name
dimensions.description: Last name of the user who last logged on to this asset in the past 7 days. Derived from the second token of user_name in composite_user. Null when no recent logon exists.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.ud_login_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Ud Login ID
dimensions.description: Login/username of the user who last logged on to this asset in the past 7 days. Use when filtering or searching by username or logon ID.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.ud_email
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Ud Email
dimensions.description: Email address of the user who last logged on to this asset in the past 7 days. Use when asking about user email or looking up users by email.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.ud_provider
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Ud Provider
dimensions.description: Identity provider that authenticated the user (e.g., "Azure AD", "Okta"). Use when filtering logon activity by identity provider.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.ud_last_logon
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Ud Last Logon
dimensions.description: Most recent logon timestamp of the user who last logged on to this asset in the past 7 days. Use when asking "when did the user last log in", sorting by recent logon activity, or filtering by logon date. Null when no recent logon exists.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.ud_providers_by_action
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Ud Providers by Action
dimensions.description: JSON map of logon action to provider list for this user-device pair (e.g., {"login": ["Azure AD"]}). Use when inspecting per-action provider detail for user logon activity.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.ud_provider_list
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Providers
dimensions.description: Flat deduplicated list of providers captured on asset-user association events, returned as a JSON array (for example, ["CrowdStrike Falcon","nios"]).

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_ud_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfProvidersArray
dimensions.description: Count of distinct providers captured on asset-user association events. Used internally for array matching. Use when asking 'how many providers are associated with this user-device pair'.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_categories_old
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfCategoriesArray
dimensions.description: Count of categories assigned to the asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching with the 'IS EXACTLY' operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_ip_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfIpsArray
dimensions.description: Count of IP addresses on the asset. Used internally for array matching. Can indicate 'assets with multiple IPs'.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_cidrs
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfCidrsArray
dimensions.description: Count of CIDR blocks associated with the asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfProviderArray
dimensions.description: Count of discovery sources for the asset. Used internally for array matching. Use when asking 'how many providers discovered this asset' or 'assets found by multiple sources'.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_secondary_providers
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfSecondaryProvidersArray
dimensions.description: Count of secondary providers. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_mac_addresses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfMacAddressesArray
dimensions.description: Count of MAC addresses on the asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_insight_types
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfClassificationArray
dimensions.description: Count of insight classifications for this asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_insight_confidence_levels
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfConfidenceArray
dimensions.description: Count of insight confidence levels for this asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_insight_indicator_ids
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfIndicatorArray
dimensions.description: Count of insight indicators for this asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_insight_registration_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfMissingRecordsArray
dimensions.description: Count of registration indicators for this asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_insight_registration_statuses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfRegistrationStatusArray
dimensions.description: Count of registration statuses for this asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_insight_subclassifications
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfSubClassificationArray
dimensions.description: Count of insight sub-classifications for this asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Tags
dimensions.description: Merged JSON object of both user-defined and system-generated tags. Use when querying across all tags regardless of source. Filter by tag key name using 'contains' operator. For separate sources, see user_tags and system_tags.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags_all_keys
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded TagsKeys
dimensions.description: Distinct list of all tag key names across user and system tags as a JSON array. Use when asking 'what tags are available' or 'list all tag keys'. For values under a specific key, use combined_tags_values_for_a_key.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.combined_tags_values_for_a_key
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded TagsValuesForGivenKey
dimensions.description: Distinct values for a specific tag key as a JSON array. Requires combined_tags filter set to the desired key name. Use when asking 'what are the values for tag X'. For listing all keys, see combined_tags_all_keys.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.empty_insight_confidences
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Empty Insight Confidences
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no insight confidence levels. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.empty_insight_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Empty Insight Indicators
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no insight indicators. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.empty_indicator_rule_ids
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Empty Indicator Rule IDs
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no indicator rule IDs. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.empty_insight_registration_indicators
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Empty Insight Registration Indicators
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no registration indicators. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.empty_insight_registration_statuses
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Empty Insight Registration Statuses
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no registration statuses. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.empty_insight_sub_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Empty Insight Sub Classifications
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no insight sub-classifications. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.empty_insight_classifications
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Empty Insight Classifications
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no insight classifications. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.empty_severities
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Empty Severities
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no insight severities. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.empty_insight_states
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Empty Insight States
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no insight states. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.empty_violations
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Empty Violations
dimensions.description: True when the asset has no violations. Used internally to handle null/empty arrays in filters.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.overall_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded OverallStatus
dimensions.description: Overall health and discovery status of the device. Use when asking 'what is the device status' or filtering by overall health.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.reachable_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded ReachedStatus
dimensions.description: Whether the device is reachable via network (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking 'is the device reachable', 'unreachable devices', or checking network connectivity.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.snmp_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded SNMPCollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether SNMP collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking 'is SNMP enabled' or 'devices with SNMP on/off'.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.snmp_credential_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded SNMPCredentialStatus
dimensions.description: Status of the SNMP credential check (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking 'SNMP credential issues' or filtering by SNMP authentication status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.snmp_collection_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded SNMPCollectionStatus
dimensions.description: Status of SNMP data collection (e.g., "Success", "Failed"). Use when asking 'SNMP collection issues' or checking if SNMP data was successfully collected.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.cli_credential_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded CLICredentialStatus
dimensions.description: Status of CLI (SSH/Telnet) credential validation. Use when checking CLI authentication status across devices.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.cli_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded CLICollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether CLI (SSH/Telnet) collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking 'is CLI collection enabled' or filtering by CLI status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.finger_print_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded FingerPrintStatus
dimensions.description: Status of device fingerprinting for device type identification. Use when checking if device type was successfully identified.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.sdn_collection_enabled
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded SDNCollectionEnabled
dimensions.description: Whether SDN collection is enabled for this device. Use when asking 'is SDN enabled' on devices.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.sdn_collection_status
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded SDNCollectionStatus
dimensions.description: Status of SDN (Software Defined Networking) data collection. Use when checking SDN integration status.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.taxonomy_origins
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded taxonomy_origins
dimensions.description: All taxonomy origin classifications as a JSON array (e.g., ["cloud", "on-prem"]). Full list per asset. For grouping or filtering by individual origin, use taxonomy_origin instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.taxonomy_origin
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded taxonomy_origin
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy origin (unnested). Values like "cloud", "on-prem". Use when grouping or filtering by origin, e.g., 'show cloud vs on-prem assets'. For the full list per asset, use taxonomy_origins.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.taxonomy_resource_types
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded taxonomy_resource_types
dimensions.description: All taxonomy resource type classifications as a JSON array. Full list per asset. For grouping or filtering by individual resource type, use taxonomy_resource_type instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.taxonomy_resource_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded taxonomy_resource_type
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy resource type (unnested). Use when grouping or filtering by resource type classification. For the full list per asset, use taxonomy_resource_types.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.taxonomy_super_categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Category
dimensions.description: All taxonomy super category classifications as a JSON array (e.g., ["compute", "iot"]). For grouping or filtering by individual value, use taxonomy_super_category. For the simpler single-value classification, see super_category.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_categories
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfTaxonomySuperCategoriesArray
dimensions.description: Count of categories assigned to the asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching with the 'IS EXACTLY' operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.taxonomy_super_category
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded taxonomy_super_category
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy super category (unnested). Use when grouping by taxonomy-based super category. Multi-valued from the taxonomy system, unlike super_category. For display, use taxonomy_super_category_label. For the full list, use taxonomy_super_categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.taxonomy_super_categories_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded taxonomy_super_categories_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted taxonomy super categories as a JSON array (e.g., ["Compute", "IoT"]). For individual display labels, use taxonomy_super_category_label. For raw values, see taxonomy_super_categories.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.taxonomy_super_category_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded taxonomy_super_category_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted individual taxonomy super category (e.g., "IoT", "Compute"). Prefer this over taxonomy_super_category for display. For the full array, see taxonomy_super_categories_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.taxonomy_types
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Type
dimensions.description: All taxonomy type classifications as a JSON array. Most granular level of taxonomy. For grouping or filtering by individual type, use taxonomy_type instead.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.length_taxonomy_types
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded LengthOfTaxonomyTypesArray
dimensions.description: Count of taxonomy types assigned to the asset. Used internally by the query builder for array matching with the 'IS EXACTLY' operator.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.taxonomy_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded taxonomy_type
dimensions.description: Individual taxonomy type (unnested). Most specific taxonomy classification. Use when grouping or filtering by the most detailed asset type. For display, use taxonomy_type_label. For the full list, use taxonomy_types.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.taxonomy_types_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded taxonomy_types_labels
dimensions.description: Display-formatted taxonomy types as a JSON array with dictionary lookups. 'Uncategorized' for unknown types. For individual labels, use taxonomy_type_label. For raw values, see taxonomy_types.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.taxonomy_type_label
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded taxonomy_type_label
dimensions.description: Display-formatted individual taxonomy type with dictionary lookup. Falls back to raw value or 'Uncategorized'. Prefer this over taxonomy_type for display. For the full array, see taxonomy_types_label.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.taxonomy_path
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded taxonomy_path
dimensions.description: Full taxonomy hierarchy path as a JSON array of 'origin/resource_type/super_category/type' strings (e.g., ["cloud/infrastructure/compute/virtual_machine"]). Use when displaying the complete taxonomy hierarchy.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.os_type
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded OSType
dimensions.description: Type or family of operating system (e.g., "IOS-XE", "Windows", "Linux"). Use when grouping by OS family or filtering by OS type. For the full OS name, see os. For the version number, see os_version.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.os_version
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded OSVersion
dimensions.description: Specific version of the operating system (e.g., "17.3.4", "22.04"). Use when filtering by exact OS version or checking for outdated versions. For the OS family, see os_type. For the full OS name, see os.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.serial_number
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded SerialNumber
dimensions.description: Hardware serial number of the device. Use when looking up a specific device by serial number.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.os_build
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded OSBuild
dimensions.description: Build number or identifier of the operating system (e.g., "22H2", "19045.3086"). Use when filtering by specific OS build or identifying patch levels.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.parent_container_id
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded ParentContainerId
dimensions.description: Identifier of the parent container this asset belongs to, when the asset was discovered as part of a container or virtualization hierarchy. Empty for standalone assets. Use when associating assets with their parent container.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.os_eos
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded OSEndOfSale
dimensions.description: Date when the OS version reaches End of Support (vendor stops providing updates). Use when asking 'which assets are past end of support' or identifying unsupported OS versions. For end of life, see os_eol. For end of security patches, see os_eossec.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.os_eol
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded OSEndOfLife
dimensions.description: Date when the OS version reaches End of Life (no longer maintained). Use when asking 'which assets are end of life', 'EOL devices', or identifying fully retired OS versions. For end of support, see os_eos. For end of security patches, see os_eossec.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.os_eossec
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded OSEndOfSecuritySupport
dimensions.description: Date when security patches stop for this OS version. Use when asking 'which assets won't receive security patches' or assessing security risk from outdated OS. For end of support, see os_eos. For end of life, see os_eol.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.os_release_date
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded OSReleaseDate
dimensions.description: When this OS version was originally released. Use when asking 'how old is this OS version' or checking release timeline. For latest available version date, see os_latest_version_date.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.os_latest_version_date
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded OSLatestVersionDate
dimensions.description: Date of the latest available version for this OS family. Use when comparing current version age against the latest available update. For the original release date, see os_release_date.

dimensions.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.logon_user_names
dimensions.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded UseridToUserNameMap
dimensions.description: Map of logon user IDs to user names as a JSON object. Use when displaying which users logged into an asset along with their display names.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.count
measures.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Count
measures.description: Total number of asset rows. In this aggregated cube each asset produces one row, so this equals the asset count. Use when asking 'how many assets' or 'total count'. For a deduplicated count by unique identifier, use assetsCount. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.assetsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Assets Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets (unique CQIDs). Each asset is counted once regardless of grouping. Use when asking 'how many assets', 'how many devices', or 'asset count'. Prefer this over count for deduplicated totals. For only assets with insights, use insightsCount.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insightsCount
measures.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Insights Count
measures.description: Number of distinct assets that have at least one security insight or violation. Use when asking 'how many assets have insights', 'assets with issues', or 'assets with violations'. Unlike assetsCount which counts all assets, this only includes those with active insight sub-classifications.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.percent
measures.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Percent
measures.description: Percentage of rows relative to the total result set. Use when asking 'what percentage of total' for row-level breakdowns. For percentage of unique assets, use assetsPercent. For percentage of assets with insights, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.assetsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Assets Percent
measures.description: Percentage of unique assets relative to total unique assets in the result. Use when asking 'what percentage of assets', 'asset distribution', or 'share of assets' grouped by a dimension. For row-level percentages, use percent. For insight-specific percentages, use insightsPercent.

measures.name: Asset_Insight_UserData_Agg_Expanded.insightsPercent
measures.title: Asset Insight User Data Agg Expanded Insights Percent
measures.description: Percentage of assets-with-insights relative to total assets-with-insights. Use when asking 'what percentage of insights' or 'insight distribution' grouped by a dimension. For general asset percentages, use assetsPercent instead.
